天機|福德.watch: You may go back and forth over small things. When you notice you're thinking about it a third time, stop and do something with your hands. Once your hands get moving, your mind often quiets by itself and your mood eases too.
天機|福德.ask_next: Is there something you keep turning over in your mind but haven't said out loud yet?

天機|父母.title: Elders like to reason things out and offer advice
天機|父母.plain: With Tian Ji (a main star) in the Parents Palace, your parents or main elders may be people with many ideas who like to analyze and are good at giving opinions. They often show care through reminders and suggestions rather than doing things for you directly. What matters in how you communicate is that it makes sense: when the reasoning is clear, you get along well. At work, your boss is also often quick-minded and changeable, and getting along with them means keeping up with their pace.
天機|父母.strength: Elders and bosses can often give you very practical advice, and asking them when you hit a difficulty often saves you many detours. You can also often discuss things with them like friends.
天機|父母.watch: When there's too much advice, you may feel nagged. Try what seems useful first, and for the rest just say thanks and take it in. You don't need to respond to every sentence.
天機|父母.ask_next: Which piece of advice from an elder or boss are you still deciding whether to follow?

太陽|命宮.title: Like sunlight, you tend to look after others first
太陽|命宮.plain: With Tai Yang (a main star (the Sun star)) in your Life Palace, you're warm and straightforward. You act openly and aboveboard, and you don't talk in circles. You naturally look after the people around you, and when you see someone struggling you can't help but lend a hand. You like being seen and are willing to step up and take responsibility, and in a crowd you're often the one who sets the mood. But you give out more than you take in, and sometimes you're so busy caring for everyone that you forget you need care too.
太陽|命宮.strength: The moment you step in, people feel warmth and reliability. When someone needs to stand up, you're often the first to speak. People remember your kindness.
太陽|命宮.watch: You may give too much and wear yourself out. Before agreeing to something, check your own schedule and keep a little energy for yourself. Only if you look after yourself can you keep looking after others for long.
太陽|命宮.ask_next: Lately, who do you most want to take good care of: the people around you, or yourself?

太陽|兄弟.title: Used to being the backbone for your siblings
太陽|兄弟.plain: Among siblings and peers, you're often the one who gives more. With Tai Yang in the Siblings Palace, you reach out and help without being asked, sometimes looking after everyone like a half-parent. One of your siblings may be more outgoing or better known, and you stay in close, frank contact. At work, you often step forward among your peers to coordinate and speak up for everyone. People see you as loyal, and they tend to come to you first when something comes up.
太陽|兄弟.strength: You're generous with your peers. People think of you when they need something, and that warmth makes your bonds deep. These bonds often last for many years.
太陽|兄弟.watch: You can easily take everything onto yourself. Before you help, ask what the other person really needs, so good intentions don't become a burden. Sometimes sitting and listening is the best help.
太陽|兄弟.ask_next: Are you helping a sibling or peer with something right now?

太陽|夫妻.title: Generous in love
太陽|夫妻.plain: With Tai Yang in the Spouse Palace, you give freely in love. You like looking after your partner and arranging things for them. You may be drawn to people who are cheerful, energetic, and visible out in the world. Your partner is often outgoing and driven in their career, and the two of you are lively and direct, saying what's on your mind. But when they get busy, you may feel put second. Say out loud the company you want, rather than quietly waiting.
太陽|夫妻.strength: When love is going well, you're like two people cheering each other on, heading out into the world together and gladly spending time and care on each other. People around you can see how well you fit.
太陽|夫妻.watch: You may feel you give more than you get. Rather than keeping score in your head, try saying plainly, "I'd like to have dinner with you this week." Saying it gives them a chance to respond.
太陽|夫妻.ask_next: In love, do you want to be seen more, or to have more time together?

太陽|子女.title: Warm toward children like a bright sun
太陽|子女.plain: You're warm toward children, students, and younger people. You like to play with them, teach them things, and stand up for them. With Tai Yang in the Children Palace, your children are often lively, outgoing, and fond of expressing themselves. Your bond is lively and direct, and you're proud of them. This palace also relates to your creativity and self-expression, and what you make often carries a wish to be seen and shared.
太陽|子女.strength: You're good at encouraging younger people. One word of recognition can give them confidence, and your support often helps them dare to go out into the world. Your warmth becomes their backing.
太陽|子女.watch: Too much enthusiasm can turn into arranging everything for them. Step back and let them try, and just watch from the side. If they stumble and get back up, they gain more confidence.
太陽|子女.ask_next: Right now, do you most want to keep a child or younger person company, or speak up on their behalf?

太陽|財帛.title: Money mostly arrives with reputation
太陽|財帛.plain: With Tai Yang in the Wealth Palace, your income is often tied to being seen: exposure, reputation, word of mouth, and work that faces the public tend to bring money in. You're generous with money, quick to spend, and don't mind picking up the bill or helping friends. When you earn a lot, you often give a lot too, so money comes in easily and goes out fast. It suits you to build your name and expertise first, and let money follow.
太陽|財帛.strength: Your generosity makes people want to work with you. Once word of mouth spreads, income opportunities tend to grow and your path widens. A good reputation is an asset in itself.
太陽|財帛.watch: You may find it hard to say no to treating people or lending money. Each month, set aside what you plan to save first, then spend the rest freely. You can be generous and stay within your means.
太陽|財帛.ask_next: For your income, would you rather widen your exposure or hold steady with the clients you have?

太陽|疾厄.title: Energy flows outward, easy to forget to stop
太陽|疾厄.plain: Your energy goes outward. You push hard during the day and often work until dark before thinking of rest. With Tai Yang in the Health Palace, you tend to work off stress through action, and the more there is to do, the more drive you have, but fatigue can build up without you noticing. Your rhythm is closely tied to day and night. Following the sun, active by day and quiet at night, feels best for you. Staying up late and flipping day and night is what most easily drags your spirits down.
太陽|疾厄.strength: When your routine is regular, your energy is remarkably good. You can get a lot done in a day, and your mood stays bright and open. You're also especially infectious when you work.
太陽|疾厄.watch: You may push too hard by day and then be unable to sleep. After evening, slow your pace and plan fewer things that excite you. Let your body slow down along with the daylight.
太陽|疾厄.ask_next: Lately, do you often go to bed late and get up early, then push through the day?

太陽|遷移.title: Heading out, a bigger stage
太陽|遷移.plain: With Tai Yang in the Travel Palace, you often shine more outside than at home. When you go out, travel for work, or arrive somewhere new, you open doors easily and people remember you. Your social luck is mostly out in the world, and you warm up quickly even with strangers. This placement also suggests you do well developing outward, and your chances often lie beyond your hometown and familiar circles. But after shining outside, you may feel tired at home and need some quiet.
太陽|遷移.strength: In a new setting, you lift the mood, meet people quickly, and become known. You often meet people who appreciate you away from home. The farther you go, the bigger your stage.
太陽|遷移.watch: Out in the world, you may keep giving and find it hard to say no. Between trips, schedule one day to do nothing. Once you're fully recharged, your next outing will shine even more.
太陽|遷移.ask_next: Is there an opportunity to go out into the world that you're thinking about taking?

太陽|交友.title: Many friends, and lively ones
太陽|交友.plain: Your circle of friends is large, with people from all walks of life. With Tai Yang in the Friends Palace, you're warm toward friends, generous in lending a hand and introducing opportunities, and people enjoy your company. But with many friends comes a lot of effort, and sometimes after looking after everyone, you notice few can truly hear your worries. In a team, you're often the one who connects with the outside and brings people together.
太陽|交友.strength: Your network is wide, so when you need help you can often find the right person, and friends often start new collaborations because of you. Many good things begin with your warmth.
太陽|交友.watch: You may wear yourself out by being equally warm to everyone. Sort out who your close friends are and spend your energy on the right people. Close friends don't need to be many; a few is plenty.
太陽|交友.ask_next: In your relationships, do you feel you give too much, or do you want to meet more people?

太陽|官祿.title: Suited to standing in front and being seen
太陽|官祿.plain: With Tai Yang in the Career Palace, you work with drive and initiative. You like to show your ability at work and hope your effort is seen. Work that faces people, such as public speaking, leading a team, or serving the public, suits you best. You're deeply committed to your career and are often the first to arrive and the last to leave. Once your work earns a name, opportunities tend to come one after another, but you can also easily give too much of your time to work.
太陽|官祿.strength: Once you commit, you lift the whole team's morale. You act openly and fairly, and it's easy for bosses and clients to trust you. Your effort is also easily seen and remembered.
太陽|官祿.watch: You can easily treat work as everything. Keep at least one evening a week completely free of work, so you truly clock out. When you're rested, you'll shine even more on stage the next day.
太陽|官祿.ask_next: At work right now, which of your efforts do you most want to be seen?

太陽|田宅.title: A lively home, door often open
太陽|田宅.plain: You like a home that's bright, airy, and sunny, and the atmosphere is lively, with relatives and friends coming and going. With Tai Yang in the Property Palace, you're willing to give a lot for your family and often take care of household matters on your own initiative. This palace also relates to your attitude toward your house and family property, and you're more willing to spend money on making your family comfortable. But with so many people and so much going on, you may rarely have time that's fully your own.
太陽|田宅.strength: When the atmosphere at home is warm, your mood brightens too. You come home to someone to talk to and feel a strong sense of belonging. That liveliness is also your best way to recharge.
太陽|田宅.watch: You may carry everything at home yourself. Share some chores and decisions with others, and you can catch your breath at home. Your family is often glad to take some on.
太陽|田宅.ask_next: What do you want to change: the place you live, or how people get along at home?

太陽|福德.title: Happiness comes from giving and being needed
太陽|福德.plain: With Tai Yang in the Well-being Palace, your happiness often comes from the satisfaction of helping others. When you see people around you doing better because of you, it feels worth it. You're optimistic, so even when something upsets you, you don't sink for long and soon find your energy again. But you're used to putting your attention on other people and rarely ask yourself what you want. Now and then, doing one thing purely for your own joy, and for no one else, matters a lot for you.
太陽|福德.strength: You have an open, cheerful outlook and find joy in small things. Your good mood often lights up the people around you too. Your optimism is often stronger than you realize.
太陽|福德.watch: You may feel low when you sense you aren't needed. Remind yourself that even when you do nothing, you deserve to be treated well. Be a little kinder to yourself first, so that giving doesn't turn into forcing yourself.
太陽|福德.ask_next: Lately, is there one thing you'd like to do just for yourself, and not for anyone else?

太陽|父母.title: Elders who are warm and have expectations
太陽|父母.plain: Your parents or elders are often warm, outgoing people who care about their reputation. They may be busy outside the home, or take good care of relatives and friends. With Tai Yang in the Parents Palace, you learn generosity and a sense of responsibility from them, and you also feel their expectations of you. At work, you tend to meet bosses who are happy to help younger people move up and who speak plainly. With them, being honest and taking the initiative to give something back earns the most trust and care.
太陽|父母.strength: Elders and bosses often reach out a hand on their own, giving you a chance to step up or giving you resources. You are also good at turning that trust into results.
太陽|父母.watch: You may feel you only count as good if you meet your elders' expectations. First, say clearly which direction you want to take, so they know your plans. Once you've made it clear, they can support you even better.
太陽|父母.ask_next: With your parents or your boss, is there something you'd like to talk through properly?

武曲|命宮.title: A person of action who does what they say
武曲|命宮.plain: With Wu Qu in your Life Palace, you're upright and decisive. You don't talk around things, and you value efficiency. You trust practical results. More than fine words, you care whether the job is finished and the money is counted clearly. You can endure hardship and you're resilient, so when trouble comes you roll up your sleeves and handle it yourself. Others may find you a bit hard or hard to approach, but you're simply putting all your effort into getting things done, and you're very loyal to your own people.
武曲|命宮.strength: When your goal is clear, your follow-through is strong. If you say you'll do it, you do it, and the more you have to push, the more results you can hold up. People see what you've done and feel reassured.
武曲|命宮.watch: Speaking too bluntly can make people think you're angry. After you've said the important part, add a line about what you meant, and the other person will take it in more easily.
武曲|命宮.ask_next: What do you most want to push forward with action right now: work, money, or a relationship?

武曲|兄弟.title: Practical and loyal among peers
武曲|兄弟.plain: With Wu Qu in the Siblings Palace, you deal with your siblings and close peers in a direct way. You say what needs saying and don't bother much with politeness. They may be firm and strong-minded, so there's occasional friction, but when something really happens, everyone pitches in. This palace also relates to money between peers, and settling accounts clearly actually makes the bond better. At work, your peers are also mostly people who get things done and value efficiency.
武曲|兄弟.strength: When you need help, your peers step in directly without dragging their feet, and the support between you is real. When you need hands, one word is enough.
武曲|兄弟.watch: With siblings, things can easily get stuck over money or who does what. Saying up front who pays how much and who does how much clears up many misunderstandings. When accounts are settled, the affection is easier to keep.
武曲|兄弟.ask_next: With your siblings, is there some money or division of work that needs to be made clear?

武曲|夫妻.title: Practical in love, light on sweet talk
武曲|夫妻.plain: In love, you're practical and show care through actions more than words. With Wu Qu in the Spouse Palace, you may be drawn to people who are capable, independent, and financially able. Your partner is often rather strong and has their own opinions, and neither of you is much for acting sweet. Your life together often centers on working hard side by side and making a good life, and the bond grows slowly through doing things together. But with so few soft words, your partner sometimes doesn't know what you're thinking.
武曲|夫妻.strength: You're like partners striving together, planning your life and home matters well, and you're especially dependable when trouble comes. The road you've walked together is your most solid bond.
武曲|夫妻.watch: When you're both hard, words can come out harsh. After an argument, remember to first say "I'm not against you," to soften the mood.
武曲|夫妻.ask_next: In love, do you want more tenderness, or more shared goals?

武曲|子女.title: Practical with the younger generation, and very responsible
武曲|子女.plain: With Wu Qu in the Children Palace, your care for children, students, or younger people is practical. You care whether they can stand on their own and whether they have a skill. Your children are often people with character and their own views, even a little stubborn. You may not talk much together, and you're more used to caring for them through actions and arranging what needs arranging. This palace also relates to what you make with your own hands. You value usefulness in what you make, and solid work matters more than flashy work.
武曲|子女.strength: What you give the younger generation is real ability and support. When they grow up they're often quite independent and grateful for your care. That steadiness stays with them for a long time.
武曲|子女.watch: When you're too strict, younger people may clash head-on with you. Now and then saying "you did well" works better than ten reminders. A child who has been affirmed is actually more willing to listen to you.
武曲|子女.ask_next: What worries you more about your child or a younger person: their ability or their temperament?

武曲|財帛.title: A feel for money, and able to hold on to it
武曲|財帛.plain: This is a very comfortable position for Wu Qu. You have a real sense of money, you count clearly, and you earn well through your own effort and expertise. You believe more in "you reap what you sow" and don't much trust good luck falling from the sky. You tend to earn through practical skills, management, or work involving numbers. You're also good at saving, but sometimes you focus so much on money that you put yourself under great stress, even calculating while you rest.
武曲|財帛.strength: You manage money with discipline and keep income and spending clear. By steady, solid work, your finances often grow more secure. With some room in hand, you decide more calmly.
武曲|財帛.watch: You may take money too seriously and feel pained by spending even a little. Set aside a small budget you can use freely, so you can relax now and then. Knowing how to spend is also a skill.
武曲|財帛.ask_next: Right now, would you rather earn a bit more, or keep a bit more?

武曲|疾厄.title: Under pressure, you tend to grit your teeth and hold on
武曲|疾厄.plain: With Wu Qu in the Health Palace, you face pressure in a hard way: the more tired you are, the more you push, and the busier you are, the harder you work, rarely letting yourself stop. Your rhythm is like a powerful machine that runs hard but can easily be overused without you noticing. You're used to treating rest as a reward for finishing, so the day of finishing often never comes. For you, putting rest into your schedule and treating it as seriously as work is the way to last.
武曲|疾厄.strength: Your willpower is strong and your base is tough. As long as your routine is in order, you can sustain intense work for a long stretch. What you build up is also impressive.
武曲|疾厄.watch: You may overlook signs of tiredness and keep charging until you can't go on. Set a finish time for yourself and put things down when it comes. When you've rested well, you'll often work faster the next day.
武曲|疾厄.ask_next: Over the past week, on how many days did you really rest well?

武曲|遷移.title: Striving away from home, getting stronger as you go
武曲|遷移.plain: Working in another place, doing sales, or breaking new ground in a new environment, you can endure hardship and make your mark through real ability. With Wu Qu in the Travel Palace, you have special fighting strength when you venture out. What others see of you outside is someone capable, reliable, and true to their word. But outside you often hold yourself very tight and are rather direct with people. Learning to leave a little flexibility beyond the firmness will make negotiations go more smoothly.
武曲|遷移.strength: Your resilience is especially strong when you strive away from home. The more unfamiliar the setting, the more it stirs your determination to get things done. Places far away are often where you make a name.
武曲|遷移.watch: Outside, you can easily clash head-on and come on too strong in talks. Listen to the other side's terms first, then state your bottom line. Leave a little room, and the partnership will last longer.
武曲|遷移.ask_next: Are you considering building something in another place, or taking a job that means traveling often?

武曲|交友.title: Few friends, but all of them real
武曲|交友.plain: With Wu Qu in the Friends Palace, you make friends in a practical way. You don't care much for networking events. What matters to you is that people can help each other and keep their word. The friends and coworkers around you tend to be quick, direct people who get things done. Working together is efficient, but when opinions clash, things can turn into open conflict. This palace also touches on money between friends. If you lend money or go into a partnership, agree on the rules first. It's better for both of you.
武曲|交友.strength: Your friends are often very dependable at the key moments. You don't need pleasantries with each other: you say what's needed, and they step in directly. There may not be many such friendships, but they last.
武曲|交友.watch: Talking about money or working together with friends can hurt the relationship. Putting things in writing isn't a lack of trust. It protects the friendship. Say it up front, and the friendship can last.
武曲|交友.ask_next: Is there some money matter or joint project with a friend that's weighing on you a little?

武曲|官祿.title: Efficient, and able to handle the practical work
武曲|官祿.plain: You are capable at work, and your ability to carry things out is your greatest asset. With Wu Qu in the Career Palace, you suit work that demands practical results, such as management, finance, technology, and engineering. You decide firmly and dislike dragging things out. What lands in your hands usually gets done on time. You hold yourself to high standards and your team too, which can sometimes feel like pressure to others. Your career is often built by growing your skills one step at a time.
武曲|官祿.strength: The tougher the task that needs someone to carry it, the better you do. Your superiors often hand you the important things. Your results come step by step, and everyone sees it.
武曲|官祿.watch: You may hold others to your own pace. When you assign work, leave some room for people to do it their way. They have their own rhythm, and the result isn't necessarily worse.
武曲|官祿.ask_next: Do you want to move into management, or go deeper in your expertise?

武曲|田宅.title: A home built up bit by bit
武曲|田宅.plain: With Wu Qu in the Property Palace, you are practical about home and where you live. You value usefulness and stability and don't chase fancy decor. You may have wanted a place of your own from early on, or you take managing the household finances very seriously. The atmosphere at home is fairly strict: everyone has their own responsibilities and the rules are clear. You're willing to spend on your home, but on the most practical things, such as making the space more usable and more durable.
武曲|田宅.strength: You run a home well. Household finances and daily arrangements are in good order, so living there feels steady and secure. Your family feels they can rely on you.
武曲|田宅.watch: Too many rules at home can make the people living with you feel tense. Now and then, set the plans aside and have a relaxed meal with your family. A home needs rules, and it needs laughter too.
武曲|田宅.ask_next: When you think about your home, are you leaning more toward moving, or toward sorting out household spending?

武曲|福德.title: A restless mind that looks for something to do
武曲|福德.plain: You have a lot of drive inside, and when you slow down you feel uneasy, as if you should be doing something to feel settled. With Wu Qu in the Well-being Palace, you find satisfaction in reaching goals. Seeing results and numbers go up makes you feel good. But this same nature makes it hard to truly relax, and you may think about work even on vacation. You need to learn that it's okay to do nothing, and give your mind some real room to rest.
武曲|福德.strength: You motivate yourself well. When you have a goal, your mood is especially steady, and however hard it gets, you find a sense of achievement in the progress. Each thing you finish settles your mind a little more.
武曲|福德.watch: You may turn even leisure into a task. Find something purely fun that you don't need to score yourself on, to give your mind an outlet. When the mind loosens now and then, your drive actually lasts longer.
武曲|福德.ask_next: When was the last time you completely put things down and truly relaxed?

武曲|父母.title: Elders who are strict, but real
武曲|父母.plain: With Wu Qu in the Parents Palace, your parents or main elders are often strong-willed, practical people who hold you to high standards. They show love very directly. They may not often say kind words, but they look after you in practical ways. Now and then you may clash over differing views. At work, your boss is also often someone who values efficiency and results. When you talk with them, bringing results and data is the most convincing.
武曲|父母.strength: Elders and bosses may be strict, but the training they give you is solid. It taught you early to work independently and handle pressure. That hard training often becomes your most reliable foundation later on.
武曲|父母.watch: Talking with elders can turn into head-on clashes. Acknowledge their intentions first, then share your different view, and they'll take it more easily. A softer tone gives your reasoning more weight.
武曲|父母.ask_next: With your parents or your boss, is there something you keep failing to agree on?

天同|命宮.title: Easygoing, and knows how to enjoy life
天同|命宮.plain: With Tian Tong in your Life Palace, you are gentle and easygoing, often wearing a smile, and people find you approachable. You don't like competing with others. More than winning or losing, you care whether everyone is getting along happily. You know how to enjoy life, love good food and comfortable days, and are easily moved. But loving comfort so much can make you a beat slow when it's time to push ahead. For you, many things are hard first and easier later, and they get smoother as time goes on.
天同|命宮.strength: Your good temper makes people want to be close to you. In conflict, you can often ease the mood with a joke. Everyone likes being around you.
天同|命宮.watch: When trouble comes, you may want to hide from it first. Give yourself a small deadline, and face it when the time comes. It will be easier to handle than you imagined.
天同|命宮.ask_next: Is there something you keep putting off and aren't quite ready to face?

天同|兄弟.title: Siblings get along warmly and look out for each other
天同|兄弟.plain: With Tian Tong in the Siblings Palace, you get along with your siblings or close peers in a warm, relaxed way, and big fights are rare. You're like friends, sharing good food and fun things. They are mostly gentle and carefree, sometimes a bit childlike. At work, you also get along well with peers and the atmosphere is harmonious. But since everyone is so agreeable, when someone needs to step up and decide, people may keep passing it to each other.
天同|兄弟.strength: The bond between you is warm. When you're feeling low, talking with them often comforts you quickly. With them around, home always feels warm, and you look out for each other when someone needs help.
天同|兄弟.watch: Everyone fears upsetting the peace, so things tend to drag with no one handling them. If you suggest an approach first, others are usually happy to follow. Once someone starts, things get moving quickly.
天同|兄弟.ask_next: Among your siblings, is there something everyone is waiting for someone else to bring up first?

天同|夫妻.title: What you want in love is ease and warmth
天同|夫妻.plain: In love, you look for comfort, ease, and the feeling of being cherished. With Tian Tong in the Spouse Palace, you may be drawn to people who are gentle, considerate, and easy to be around. Your partner is often easygoing, even a bit childlike, and the two of you are good at finding fun together. Emotional ups and downs show more in the relationship: sweet when happy, and sulky like a child when upset. The relationship grows steadier with time, and the understanding deepens later on.
天同|夫妻.strength: When things go well, you two know how to enjoy life together. A meal or a short trip can make you both very happy. That ease is your best glue.
天同|夫妻.watch: When practical problems come up, you may both want to leave them for later. Pick a relaxed moment and lay out together what needs to be faced.
天同|夫妻.ask_next: In love, do you care more about how it feels to be together, or about practical arrangements?

天同|子女.title: Close to children like a friend
天同|子女.plain: With Tian Tong in the Children Palace, you are close to children, students, or younger people, more like a big friend who plays along than a serious elder. Your children are often gentle and likable, and a bit clingy. You love them dearly and can't bear to see them struggle, so you may spoil them without meaning to. This palace also relates to your creativity and interests. You often start making things just because it's fun, and the more you do, the more you learn.
天同|子女.strength: You give younger people a strong sense of safety. They feel relaxed around you and are willing to share what's on their minds. That closeness can keep you talking easily for a lifetime.
天同|子女.watch: If you can't bear to set limits, younger people may end up with too few rules. Being gentle is fine, but state your principles clearly and follow through. When rules are clear, children actually feel safer.
天同|子女.ask_next: Right now, what would you rather give the children or younger people in your life: more time together, or more structure?

天同|財帛.title: Enough money is enough; spend it on your own comfort
天同|財帛.plain: About money, your attitude is easygoing. If you have enough and life feels comfortable, that's good enough, and you don't tend to push yourself hard for it. With Tian Tong in the Wealth Palace, you often spend on food, fun, and things that make life more pleasant. Income usually takes hard work to build first, then loosens up slowly later. A steady source of income suits you better. Pressured, highly competitive ways of earning tend to wear you out. Saving isn't hard for you. Getting started is.
天同|財帛.strength: You know how to spend money on what makes you happy, and you rarely get into conflict with others over it. Your mindset is calm. When money is spent happily, life feels easy too.
天同|財帛.watch: Small purchases can keep adding up, and you find at the end of the month that there isn't enough. Set the amount you want to save as an automatic transfer, so you don't have to rely on willpower. Once you've been saving for a while, you may find it isn't as hard as it seemed.
天同|財帛.ask_next: Would you rather start saving a sum of money, or make your income a bit steadier?

天同|疾厄.title: When your mood is good, your rhythm stays steady
天同|疾厄.plain: With Tian Tong in the Health Palace, how you feel in body and mind is closely tied to your mood. When your mood is good, you eat well, sleep well, and have plenty of energy. When stress arrives, your routine gets disrupted, you feel especially unwilling to move, and you want to put everything off. What you need is to relax, not to push yourself. Finding a daily rhythm that feels comfortable, such as a regular walk, a hot bath, or some music, will do more for you than anything else.
天同|疾厄.strength: You're good at helping yourself relax. As long as your surroundings feel comfortable, you recover your energy quickly and your mood settles easily. When body and mind loosen, your days brighten too.
天同|疾厄.watch: When you're in a bad mood, you may hide away at home all day to escape. Going out for a walk or talking with a friend is more likely to really release the stress. A little movement often lifts your mood faster than you expect.
天同|疾厄.ask_next: Lately, has stress been affecting your sleep or your eating rhythm?

天同|遷移.title: Well liked away from home, at ease wherever you go
天同|遷移.plain: With Tian Tong in the Travel Palace, people like you when you're out in the world. You're easygoing and easy to get along with, and in a new place you quickly fit in. Traveling or changing your surroundings often lifts your mood, and you easily meet people who are willing to look after you. Outside, you come across as friendly and unpretentious. But being too comfortable out there can sometimes take away your drive to push ahead. You feel this is enough and don't want to try for more.
天同|遷移.strength: Wherever you go, you tend to meet people who are easy to get along with. When you're out handling things, someone often offers a hand, and matters get settled smoothly. Your warmth opens quite a few doors for you.
天同|遷移.watch: Being content wherever you land, you may miss chances you should seize. When a good opportunity comes, first ask yourself whether you want it, and if you do, speak up.
天同|遷移.ask_next: Is there a place you'd like to go, or an environment you'd like to try?

天同|交友.title: A warm circle of friends, easy company
天同|交友.plain: The friends around you are mostly gentle, easygoing people. Everyone relaxes together and often shares meals and fun. With Tian Tong in the Friends Palace, the mood in your circle is harmonious, and there's little scheming or rivalry. In a team, colleagues get along well and look out for one another. But when everyone is this agreeable, then when someone needs to make a decision or say something hard, no one may want to be that person, and things easily drag on.
天同|交友.strength: Your friends are a big source of emotional support. Someone keeps you company when you're sad and celebrates with you when you're happy, which gives your life real warmth. These friends are an important source of nourishment in your life.
天同|交友.watch: You feel awkward turning friends down, so invitations can fill up your schedule. When you want rest, simply say you want to stay home this week. Real friends will understand, and they'll wait for you.
天同|交友.ask_next: Lately, do your get-togethers with friends recharge you, or leave you a bit tired?

天同|官祿.title: Suited to work with a good atmosphere that you can do for the long term
天同|官祿.plain: With Tian Tong in the Career Palace, what you look for at work is a harmonious environment and doing something you enjoy. You don't much like fiercely competitive, high-pressure workplaces. Work involving service, caring for people, or lifestyle taste, and roles that call for gentle communication, all suit you. Your career often starts slowly, but after a long time it becomes very steady. In a team you're the one who eases the mood, and everyone likes working with you.
天同|官祿.strength: In an environment you like, you can keep going steadily for a long time and build a very good reputation, and colleagues and clients trust you. The longer it goes, the more your value is seen.
天同|官祿.watch: You may easily feel that things are fine as they are and not want to go after more. Once in a while, think about where you'd like to be in three years, and give yourself a direction.
天同|官祿.ask_next: Is your current work something you enjoy doing, or just something you're used to doing?

天同|田宅.title: Home is where you relax
天同|田宅.plain: What you ask of a home is that it be comfortable, warm, and lived-in. With Tian Tong in the Property Palace, you like to make your home cozy, with a sofa that's good to sit on and a bed that's good to sleep in, so you can fully relax once you're back. The atmosphere at home tends to be happy, and family members get along well. You may be very attached to home and would rather stay in than go out on weekends. This palace is also linked to how settled your living situation is, and usually the further on you go, the more satisfied you become with where you live.
天同|田宅.strength: Home is your best place to recharge. Once you're back, your heart settles, and even great stress can slowly ease there. You're also good at making your home a place people want to come back to.
天同|田宅.watch: When you're too attached to home, you may miss chances outside. Occasionally accept an invitation and go out, and you'll appreciate the comfort of home even more when you return. The world outside can also add some freshness to your life.
天同|田宅.ask_next: Do you want to make your home more comfortable, or are you thinking of moving somewhere else?

天同|福德.title: Good at finding joy in small things
天同|福德.plain: With Tian Tong in the Well-being Palace, you naturally know how to enjoy life and are good at finding joy in small everyday things. A good cup of coffee or a leisurely afternoon can leave you fully content. Your outlook is optimistic, and when things go badly, you're better able to let go and see it in a broader light. You value inner fulfillment, and rather than chasing hard, you'd like to live with peace of mind. But being satisfied too easily can sometimes leave you with a little less drive to move forward.
天同|福德.strength: Your inner world is calm. Even when storms rage outside, you can find a quiet place for yourself and live your life well. This steadiness also makes the people around you feel comfortable.
天同|福德.watch: When you're satisfied too easily, you may keep putting off what you want to do. Pick one small goal and start moving a little. Going bit by bit is also a comfortable way to move forward.
天同|福德.ask_next: What small things have made you happy lately? Is there anything you'd like to do more of?

天同|父母.title: Elders are fond of you, and getting along is gentle
天同|父母.plain: Your parents or main elders are often gentle, easy-to-talk-to people who are fond of you and don't tend to manage you in a harsh way. With Tian Tong in the Parents Palace, getting along with them is relaxed, and you can say what you need to slowly. At work, you also tend to meet good-tempered bosses who are willing to look after people. With them, if you're sincere and polite, you can usually receive a lot of care. But being too protected can sometimes mean you learn to make your own decisions a bit later.
天同|父母.strength: Elders and bosses are often very tolerant of you and willing to give you another chance when you make mistakes, letting you grow slowly in a warm environment. You also pass that warmth on to the people around you.
天同|父母.watch: You're used to being looked after, so when something comes up you may wait for your elders to offer an idea. For important matters, work out a plan of your own first, then ask them for advice. Once you've made your own decision, their advice becomes more useful.
天同|父母.ask_next: Is there something you want to decide yourself but are still waiting for an elder's opinion on?

廉貞|命宮.title: Someone with principles and finesse
廉貞|命宮.plain: With Lian Zhen in the Life Palace, you have your own yardstick in what you do, and you're clear about what to do and what not to touch. You know how to speak to suit the occasion, you can hold your own in a crowd, and you carry a desire to win. You look calm on the outside, but your feelings are very fine-grained, and you just don't easily let people see them. You can use this sense of proportion in roles that involve coordination, negotiation, or managing rules, so people know working with you is reassuring, and also leave yourself some time to truly relax.
廉貞|命宮.strength: When you're at your best, you can find the balance point in complicated relationships and get things settled without embarrassing either side, and everyone respects you for it.
廉貞|命宮.watch: You can get stuck on face and competitiveness, pushing on even when you're tired. Try putting down your guard with someone you trust and saying, "I need help." Things often move faster that way.
廉貞|命宮.ask_next: Right now, do you most want to use this finesse at work, or in love?

廉貞|兄弟.title: Siblings call for a sense of proportion
廉貞|兄弟.plain: With siblings and close peers, Lian Zhen in your Siblings Palace makes you more like partners who each keep their own territory. You care about each other, but boundaries matter a lot to you, and you remember who crossed one. You may quietly compare yourselves, yet at the key moment you'll stand up for each other. Saying things up front and keeping matters clear helps the bond last longer. For partnerships or loans, putting it in writing works better than relying on an unspoken understanding, and leaves less that's hard to sort out later.
廉貞|兄弟.strength: When things go well, a sibling or peer is someone you can really talk things through with. Planning together, you divide the work clearly and move efficiently, and you back each other up when trouble comes.
廉貞|兄弟.watch: The most common snag is small things piling up into a lasting grudge. When something bothers you, say so early, keep your tone even and stick to the matter at hand, rather than waiting for an outburst and then going back over the whole account.
廉貞|兄弟.ask_next: Which sibling at home have you been meaning to clear the air with lately?

廉貞|夫妻.title: Loyalty and boundaries matter in love
廉貞|夫妻.plain: With Lian Zhen in the Spouse Palace, your expectations of a partner are vivid: sincere, sensible, and someone you can admire. At the start you throw yourself in, with strong heat and attraction. Over time you take rules and commitments very seriously. You're drawn to talented people with character, but when both of you are strong, who bends first becomes the lesson. Talk more about feelings and less about winning or losing, and the relationship loosens up a lot, so you don't have to keep holding it up alone.
廉貞|夫妻.strength: When love goes well, you're each other's best ally. You pursue goals together, give each other face in front of others, and look after each other in private.
廉貞|夫妻.watch: Arguments can turn into a contest over who's right. Pause, take a deep breath, and ask yourself: right now, do I want to win, or do I want to be truly understood?
廉貞|夫妻.ask_next: Right now, what matters more to you: your partner's attitude, or the commitment between you?

廉貞|子女.title: Demanding of the younger ones, and protective too
廉貞|子女.plain: With Lian Zhen in the Children Palace, you expect a lot from children, students, or the juniors you mentor. You want them to have discipline and to make something of themselves. You protect them in your own way: strict in words, but deeply caring inside. This palace also touches your creative work and the people you guide, and what you make usually has character and sharp edges. Try giving a bit more choice, so they have room to grow inside the frame you draw. It will be easier for both of you.
廉貞|子女.strength: You're good at developing people. When it goes well, those you guide work with method and backbone, and years later they still remember your advice and come back to thank you.
廉貞|子女.watch: Holding too tight makes them want to run. Cut the rules down to the three that matter most, and let them try and make mistakes on the rest while you simply watch.
廉貞|子女.ask_next: Which child or junior are you most unable to stop worrying about lately?

廉貞|財帛.title: Earning through strategy and connections
廉貞|財帛.plain: When it comes to money, with Lian Zhen in the Wealth Palace you rely on your head and your relationships. You're good at seeing the rules and finding the way in. Work involving negotiation, public relations, or management systems suits you, and your income is often tied to the network you tend. You also care about appearances when spending, and don't hold back when it's time to host or give gifts. Set yourself a spending limit, especially for social obligations and face-saving costs, and keep your money for what truly gives you peace of mind. You'll feel steadier.
廉貞|財帛.strength: When luck is with you, you can spot opportunities in complicated situations that others miss, negotiate terms in your favor, and your income rises along with it.
廉貞|財帛.watch: Spending extra for face, or competing with someone out of pride, is where money slips away most easily. Before you spend, ask: who is this money really for?
廉貞|財帛.ask_next: Right now, would you rather earn a bit more, or first get a handle on what you're spending?

廉貞|疾厄.title: Loosen up first when your emotions tighten
廉貞|疾厄.plain: With Lian Zhen in the Health Palace, your state is closely tied to your mood. When something is on your mind, you often keep working while holding it in. It doesn't show on the surface, but your routine slips first. You tend to push through until things are done before resting, so stress can pile up all at once. Give yourself regular time to unwind, like a walk after work or no work messages before bed, so the tension has an outlet. When your rhythm steadies, your spirits steady too.
廉貞|疾厄.strength: Once you find a routine that suits you, you stick with it. Your discipline is steadier than most, you bounce back quickly after rest, and you rarely drag things out.
廉貞|疾厄.watch: Keeping feelings bottled up wears you down most. When you're tired, let yourself stop and talk with someone you trust. It helps far more than forcing your way through.
廉貞|疾厄.ask_next: Lately, is your biggest source of pressure work, relationships, or home?

廉貞|遷移.title: Opening doors through people outside
廉貞|遷移.plain: Once you leave familiar surroundings, with Lian Zhen in the Travel Palace you actually feel more eager to show what you can do. Out in the world you manage your image well and can quickly work out a collaboration with strangers. Business trips, postings elsewhere, or building a life in a new city are often when you open up new ground. But outside settings are complicated, with many social obligations, so tell real friends from those who are only for show. Observe first and open your heart more slowly, and you're less likely to get pulled into other people's affairs.
廉貞|遷移.strength: In other places or new settings, you do well. Helpful people often come through social gatherings and introductions, one link at a time, so your network widens and opportunities grow.
廉貞|遷移.watch: Social pressure from outside can make you agree to too much. When you decline, give a clear reason and offer an alternative. You don't have to take everything on for the sake of face.
廉貞|遷移.ask_next: Lately, are you thinking of changing your environment, or do you want to widen your network out in the world?

廉貞|交友.title: Friends are about reliability, not numbers
廉貞|交友.plain: With Lian Zhen in the Friends Palace, your circle of friends has clear layers: a few at the core, and the rest are working or social ties. You value loyalty, step in when a friend needs help, and expect the same in return. Colleagues, clients, and teammates also belong to this palace, and you're good at finding the people who are useful in a team. Say your expectations out loud instead of quietly keeping score, and there will be far fewer misunderstandings, and you won't have to sulk alone.
廉貞|交友.strength: When things go well, you have a few friends who can share a heavy load. Day to day, you each stay busy, but at the key moment one phone call is enough, and you can rely on each other.
廉貞|交友.watch: Shutting the door completely after being let down once can make you miss people who are actually worth keeping. Ask what happened first, then decide whether to let go.
廉貞|交友.ask_next: Which friendship or work relationship is weighing on your mind most right now?

廉貞|官祿.title: Suited to managing rules and negotiating
廉貞|官祿.plain: At work, Lian Zhen in the Career Palace gives you strong ambition. You like positions with challenges and visible results. Management, legal work, public relations, sales negotiation, and system planning, which need strategy and a sense of proportion, suit you especially well. You care about your position and being seen, and want recognition when you do well. Set a clear goal for each stage and climb step by step. You don't need to prove everything at once, and the road will take you further.
廉貞|官祿.strength: At your best, you can bring rules to a chaotic team, hold your bottom line at the negotiating table, and win good terms for everyone.
廉貞|官祿.watch: Clashing head-on with a boss or colleague tends to hurt both sides. Find your shared goal first, then discuss the differences. It takes much less effort than a direct confrontation.
廉貞|官祿.ask_next: Right now, do you want to move up in your current position, or move to a bigger stage?

廉貞|田宅.title: Home is the territory you guard
廉貞|田宅.plain: With Lian Zhen in the Property Palace, you care a lot about your own space. You have rules in mind about how things are arranged at home and who may come in. You put thought into your living space and want it to be respectable and safe. Family members may also share a set of unspoken rules. Talk through chores, space, and habits with those you live with, so each person has their own corner, and home becomes a place where you truly relax, rather than one more arena to manage.
廉貞|田宅.strength: When you take care of the household you're orderly, and you have firm views on buying a home, renting, or arranging a space. Once you've decided, you act without dragging your feet.
廉貞|田宅.watch: Caring too much about control can make family feel managed. Leave one area for others to decide, and even if it isn't to your liking, let it be for now. The mood will ease a lot.
廉貞|田宅.ask_next: Lately, are you thinking of moving or changing homes, or would you rather first put your current home in order?

廉貞|福德.title: Thinking a lot and wanting a lot
廉貞|福德.plain: You have a rich inner world. With Lian Zhen in the Well-being Palace, you have a lot of thoughts and you care about quality of life. It's hard for you to truly switch off. Your mind is often working out the next step, and sometimes it circles over small things. You enjoy things with good craft and feel, and you need some time alone to work through your emotions. Find one hobby you can throw yourself into, so your mind has somewhere to rest. That works far better than pressing thoughts down, and you'll sleep more soundly too.
廉貞|福德.strength: When your mind is settled, you have good taste in beauty and in daily life. You know when to treat yourself, and you can find energy and drive again through your interests.
廉貞|福德.watch: Overthinking can turn you against yourself. Write your worries down and split them into what you can act on and what you can't. Just finish the first group.
廉貞|福德.ask_next: What has your mind been circling around lately: one matter, or one person?

廉貞|父母.title: Each holding your ground with elders
廉貞|父母.plain: With Lian Zhen in the Parents Palace, you and your parents or elders often care about each other but find it hard to say anything soft. Their expectations of you may be clear, and you have convictions of your own, so it's easy to get pulled apart over ideas. Bosses and superiors at work are also read in this palace. With authority, you tend to watch first and then decide whether to trust. Hear their reasons out before giving yours. There will be far less conflict, and your views will be received more easily.
廉貞|父母.strength: When things go well, elders or bosses admire your ability. They're willing to give you resources and chances, and they speak up for you at key moments.
廉貞|父母.watch: You want recognition but don't want to bow your head, so both sides can get stuck. Pick one small thing and thank them for it first. That often opens the conversation.
廉貞|父母.ask_next: Which elder or boss do you most want to talk something through with right now, and what is it?

天府|命宮.title: A steady, dependable keeper
天府|命宮.plain: With Tian Fu in the Life Palace, you come across as steady and reliable. You don't panic when things happen, and you tend to see the whole picture before acting. You value security and like to arrange resources, people and time carefully. You're generous, and many people are happy to lean on you, but you also have your pride and your limits. Trust your own judgment more, and now and then step outside your comfort zone to try a new approach. Add a little flexibility to your steadiness and your road gets wider.
天府|命宮.strength: You're good at keeping hold of what you have. When things go well, you keep a team or a family in good order, and people feel at ease around you.
天府|命宮.watch: Wanting too much certainty can make you miss the moment, still thinking long after it's time to move. Give yourself a deadline. Once you've gathered about 70 to 80 percent of the information, decide when time is up.
天府|命宮.ask_next: What do you most want to protect right now: your work, your relationship, or your savings?

天府|兄弟.title: Siblings looking out for each other
天府|兄弟.plain: With Tian Fu in the Siblings Palace, you tend to get along peacefully with your brothers and sisters or close peers, and you look out for each other when something comes up. You may be the one who quietly takes on the role of coordinator, and when something happens at home, people ask you first. The support you get is often practical help, not just words. Let others pitch in too instead of handling everything yourself. The relationship will be more balanced, and you won't get so tired that you can't speak up.
天府|兄弟.strength: When things go well, siblings or good friends are a very steady backup. When you work together, your strengths complement each other: you bring the ideas, they bring the effort, and everyone can hold up their part.
天府|兄弟.watch: Being the nice one for too long is tiring, and you may feel your effort goes unseen. When it's time to say "your turn this time," say it gently but directly.
天府|兄弟.ask_next: Lately with your siblings, are you helping each other, or is the load a bit uneven?

天府|夫妻.title: Wanting a steady, lasting relationship
天府|夫妻.plain: In love, with Tian Fu in your Spouse Palace, you want stability and someone to rely on. Ideally your partner is mature and responsible, someone you can build a life with. You don't care much for big ups and downs in romance. You value whether the two of you can plan a future together. You care about face, and you hope your partner shows you respect in front of others. Say your picture of the future out loud, like where to live and how to save, so your partner knows what you're thinking and you can pull together.
天府|夫妻.strength: When love goes well, you're like a solid little team. You look after the details of daily life, talk things over together, and your days feel grounded and secure.
天府|夫妻.watch: Focusing on running life well, it's easy to forget to talk heart to heart. Now and then put down the chores and plans, and simply go on a date and talk about how you've each been feeling.
天府|夫妻.ask_next: What's on your mind right now: whether to take the next step, or how to make things steadier?

天府|子女.title: Attentive, thorough care for the younger generation
天府|子女.plain: When Tian Fu falls in the Children Palace, you take good care of children, students or juniors. You arrange what they need in daily life so they feel secure. Guiding people is like managing a storehouse for you, with resources shared out thoughtfully. Your creations and results also belong to this palace, and what you make is usually solid and durable. Leave a bit more room for them to try, and don't rush to pave every road. Let them learn to judge and take responsibility for themselves.
天府|子女.strength: The younger people in your life feel close to you and trust you. They feel safe around you, and even after they've grown up and entered the world, they're willing to come back and talk things over with you.
天府|子女.watch: Too much caring can turn into deciding for them. Try asking first, "What do you want to do?" Listen to their thoughts, then see whether to help.
天府|子女.ask_next: What have you been thinking about lately: how to accompany a child as they grow, or how to guide juniors well?

天府|財帛.title: Good at building and managing money
天府|財帛.plain: With Tian Fu in the Wealth Palace, your attitude toward money is steady and careful. You know how to live within your means, and you like watching your savings grow bit by bit. You suit work that builds up over the long term. Income may not surge, but it rarely swings wildly. You have your own plan for spending, and you think long before big purchases. Split your savings goal into stages and give yourself a small reward when you reach each one. Then saving isn't only pressure, and it's easier to keep up.
天府|財帛.strength: When your finances are steady, you feel confident. You can handle an unexpected expense without scrambling, and family and friends feel comfortable leaving money matters in your hands.
天府|財帛.watch: Being too conservative can leave money just sitting there. Set aside a small part for learning new skills or getting better tools, so your money works for you.
天府|財帛.ask_next: Right now, do you want to save a bit more, or make better use of the money you have?

天府|疾厄.title: A regular routine is your foundation
天府|疾厄.plain: Your condition is closely tied to how regular your life is, which is the character of Tian Fu in the Health Palace. With fixed meals and enough sleep, you can keep going for a long time. Once your rhythm gets disrupted, your energy slowly slips. You tend to take stress onto yourself and look fine, then feel it all at once after it builds up. Check your routine regularly. For example, keep one day a week with nothing scheduled, so your body and mind have room to return to their usual rhythm.
天府|疾厄.strength: Once you set your routine right, you're very steady. You recover well after rest, and you're better at keeping good habits over the long run without giving up halfway.
天府|疾厄.watch: Eating well and sitting a lot, it's easy not to move enough. Pick a fixed time each day to walk and stretch, so your body moves too.
天府|疾厄.ask_next: Lately, has your routine been thrown off by work, or by things at home?

天府|遷移.title: Steady and trusted when away from home
天府|遷移.plain: With Tian Fu in the Travel Palace, you give people an impression of being reliable and sensible out in the world, and even strangers feel comfortable working with you. When you're away from home, you like to get things arranged first and don't care much for last-minute changes. Changing environments, business trips or building a life elsewhere is a step-by-step process of finding your footing. Once you're familiar, reach out and meet more people. Let outside resources slowly build into your backing, and the next step gets easier.
天府|遷移.strength: Even in an unfamiliar place, you can find support quickly. Clients and partners trust you and are willing to work with you long term, and your good name spreads by word of mouth.
天府|遷移.watch: Fear of change can make you miss opportunities outside. Step out first with a short trip or a trial run, and make the big decision once you've confirmed it suits you.
天府|遷移.ask_next: Right now, do you want to head outward, or first settle firmly into the position you hold?

天府|交友.title: A steady, lasting circle of friends
天府|交友.plain: You're slow to warm up with friends, but once Tian Fu in the Friends Palace decides someone is in, it lasts. You often have old friends you've known for many years. You look after people. Friends come to you when something's wrong, and you're glad to help. This palace also covers coworkers, teams, and clients, and in a team you're often the one who steadies everyone. Now and then let friends look after you too. Accepting help is a kind of trust, and it keeps the relationship flowing both ways.
天府|交友.strength: You have a dependable network. When you need resources, one phone call brings help. You work well with others, and partnerships often last for years.
天府|交友.watch: You're so accommodating with friends that people can take too much from you. Before you say yes, think about your time and energy. Do what you reasonably can; you don't have to take on everything.
天府|交友.ask_next: Lately, among friends or coworkers, are you giving more or receiving more?

天府|官祿.title: Suited to roles that manage resources
天府|官祿.plain: With Tian Fu in the Career Palace, you suit roles that need stability and managing resources, like finance, administration, operations, HR, or any position that keeps the big picture in order. You may not be eager to come first, but you're good at protecting results and keeping things running over the long term. You're easily trusted in an organization and move up step by step. Reach for chances to lead a project, so people see your management ability and not just your steadiness. Your stage grows with it.
天府|官祿.strength: You're the anchor of your team. Systems, budgets, and staffing all get arranged well, and your manager feels at ease handing you important work.
天府|官祿.watch: You get so used to how things are that you may miss the moment to change. Once a year, pick a day and ask yourself: can this role still teach me something new?
天府|官祿.ask_next: What's on your mind right now: a promotion, a job change, or first steadying the role you have?

天府|田宅.title: Home gives you a deep sense of security
天府|田宅.plain: Home is your most important base, and that's what Tian Fu in the Property Palace shows. You like to keep your living space comfortable and settled, and you're more interested in buying a home or building assets. With family, you're often the one looking after everyone's daily life. This palace also covers holding on to assets, and you know how to build up slowly. Write your housing plans as goals for the next few years and take them one step at a time. That feels safer than deciding on impulse.
天府|田宅.strength: Your home is warm and orderly, and friends like to visit and share a meal. You're confident making decisions about the house and household, and you rarely regret them.
天府|田宅.watch: Putting too much energy into home can tie you down with chores. Share some of the load with family, and set aside a stretch of time each week that's only yours.
天府|田宅.ask_next: Lately, what are you thinking about home: buying, moving, or just tidying up properly?

天府|福德.title: Someone who knows how to enjoy life
天府|福德.plain: With Tian Fu in the Well-being Palace, you know how to live well. You like good food and a good home, and you value inner calm. You don't like being rushed, your mood is usually even, and when something happens you settle yourself first and then deal with it. Your happiness often comes from small pleasures, like a good meal or some uninterrupted time. Treat this ease as an asset. When you're busy, remind yourself to leave some time to enjoy things. Your mind will stay clearer and your judgment sharper.
天府|福德.strength: With your steady mind and good mood, you're a safe harbor for the people around you. They feel relaxed and cared for in your company, and you're at ease yourself.
天府|福德.watch: Too much comfort can make it hard to find the drive to change. Give yourself one small goal where you can see progress, so life isn't only about being comfortable.
天府|福德.ask_next: Lately, which moment made you feel most relaxed? Was it a person, a place, or an activity?

天府|父母.title: Elders are your solid backing
天府|父母.plain: With Tian Fu in the Parents Palace, your relationship with parents and elders is usually steady, and what they give you is mostly practical care and support. You were probably taught from a young age to follow rules and know your limits. At work, you also tend to meet superiors who are willing to promote you. Share how you're doing with your elders so they know you're well, and ask them for advice when you need it. Their experience can be a very useful resource for you.
天府|父母.strength: Elders or managers trust you, are willing to hand you important matters, and will lend a hand when you need it, saving you detours.
天府|父母.watch: Relying too much on elders' arrangements can leave you short of your own opinion. For important decisions, first work out what you want, then listen to their advice.
天府|父母.ask_next: Lately, is there something you'd like to talk over with an elder in your family or with your manager?

太陰|命宮.title: Gentle, perceptive, and deep-thinking
太陰|命宮.plain: With Tai Yin in the Life Palace, you're perceptive and sensitive, and you notice shifts in other people's feelings. You seem mild on the outside but have strong views inside; you just like to think things through slowly before speaking. You value home and security, you're thorough in your work, you have your own sense of beauty, and you need quiet time to sort out your feelings. Use this attentiveness on things that call for patience and observation, and learn to say your feelings out loud instead of keeping them all inside.
太陰|命宮.strength: You're warm and know your limits, so people are glad to be close to you. You also make your life feel well-crafted, and others find it comfortable to be around you.
太陰|命宮.watch: Thinking a lot and saying little can leave you feeling stuffy. When something's on your mind, pick someone you trust and say half of it. You don't have to say it all at once.
太陰|命宮.ask_next: The thing you've been keeping inside lately: is it about love or about family?

太陰|兄弟.title: A steady, lasting bond with siblings
太陰|兄弟.plain: With Tai Yin in the Siblings Palace, your bond with siblings and close peers is the slow, steady kind. You may not be in touch every day, but you each keep the other in mind. You care a lot about how your siblings feel, and a single remark can sit with you for a long time. Close female friends are often an important support for you. Send small messages to check in, and the bond will slowly warm. You don't have to wait until something happens.
太陰|兄弟.strength: Your siblings and close girlfriends are your emotional safety net. When you're down, someone is soon there to talk, share a meal, and help you think things through.
太陰|兄弟.watch: You worry so much about the other person's feelings that you swallow your hurt. Saying directly, "That comment made me a little sad," works much better than going quiet and cold.
太陰|兄弟.ask_next: Which sibling or close friend would you most like to have a heart-to-heart with right now?

太陰|夫妻.title: Longing for a gentle, caring partner
太陰|夫妻.plain: In love, with Tai Yin in the Spouse Palace, you long to be treated gently and want a partner who is attentive and understands your moods. You like a bond that grows slowly and don't care for pushy pursuit. You remember a partner's small habits and show love through caring, but you can also overthink: if a message goes unanswered, you start guessing. Say what you need clearly, like "I'd like a text from you after work," so your partner knows how to care for you.
太陰|夫妻.strength: You understand each other well. When things are going smoothly, the small details of daily life are warm, you get each other without much said, and the relationship is steady and sweet.
太陰|夫妻.watch: If a message is read but unanswered, or the tone is a little cold, you easily think the worst. Ask first before drawing conclusions, and don't play out the whole drama in your head.
太陰|夫妻.ask_next: What do you most want to know right now: what your partner is thinking, or whether you'll grow closer?

太陰|子女.title: Accompanying the younger ones like moonlight
太陰|子女.plain: With Tai Yin in the Children Palace, you're gentle with children, students, and younger people, and you're willing to spend time listening to them. Your care is quiet, and you often take care of everything without a fuss. Your creative work and results also fall in this palace, and what you make has a delicate beauty that often moves people. Let them know you care. Now and then say it outright instead of only showing it through actions, and they'll understand your heart better and feel more willing to come closer.
太陰|子女.strength: The younger people in your life are close to you. They share their thoughts and worries, and you're the first to hear their good news. You also draw a lot of strength from being with them.
太陰|子女.watch: Worrying too much about them can lead you to keep asking and fretting. Trust that they can handle things, and step in when something is really wrong. It's easier for both of you.
太陰|子女.ask_next: Lately, what weighs on you most about a child or someone younger?

太陰|財帛.title: A sense of security built up slowly
太陰|財帛.plain: With Tai Yin in the Wealth Palace, you have a fine-tuned feeling about money. You like to save a little at a time, and you feel at ease when you see your savings grow. Your income often comes from steady accumulation, or from work tied to beauty, care, or service. You don't like to show off when you spend, but you put thought into things that make life comfortable. Make saving a habit, like setting aside a fixed amount each month, and keep some money for small things that make you happy. Life will feel steady and sweet.
太陰|財帛.strength: You manage a household budget well. You keep track of money carefully and in order, and you know where every bit goes. Over time this builds savings that give you a solid sense of security.
太陰|財帛.watch: When you feel low, it's easy to comfort yourself by shopping. When you want to place an order, put it in your cart for a day first. If you still want it tomorrow once your mood has settled, it's not too late to buy.
太陰|財帛.ask_next: Lately, do you want to save a bit more, or make your income steadier?

太陰|疾厄.title: Care for mood and routine together
太陰|疾厄.plain: With Tai Yin in the Health Palace, your condition is closely tied to your mood and daily routine. When something weighs on your mind, you often toss and turn at night, and your energy dips the next day. You are sensitive to change, and a new season or a new place takes some time to adjust to. Under stress you don't say much and quietly work through it. Build a regular bedtime habit for yourself, like a hot bath or some music, so your body and mind know it's time to rest.
太陰|疾厄.strength: You know how to look after your own feelings. Once your rhythm steadies, your energy returns quickly, and you look brighter overall.
太陰|疾厄.watch: Staying up late thinking things over drains you most. Before bed, write your worries on paper, tell yourself you'll deal with them tomorrow, and then go to sleep.
太陰|疾厄.ask_next: Lately, what do you most want to get back first: good sleep, or a good mood?

太陰|遷移.title: Gentle abroad, and easy to like
太陰|遷移.plain: Out in the world, with Tai Yin in the Travel Palace, you come across as gentle and approachable, and people tend to look after you and help you. You do well in quiet environments with good quality, and when you're away you miss home a lot. A new place takes some adjusting, but once you're settled, you slowly build your own circle. Start by getting to know people in a small circle and find a few you click with. Your way outside will go much more smoothly.
太陰|遷移.strength: You have people looking out for you even away from home, and you often meet kind helpers. Your life and work settle step by step, and you slowly feel you belong.
太陰|遷移.watch: When you first arrive somewhere new, you may easily feel homesick and low. Start by making your living space comfortable, and give yourself a corner you can relax in when you come home from work.
太陰|遷移.ask_next: Right now, are you considering building a life away from home, or wondering whether to move back near home?

太陰|交友.title: Tending a few close friends with care
太陰|交友.plain: With Tai Yin in the Friends Palace, you value quality over quantity in friends, and you like people who can talk heart to heart and understand you. You remember friends' birthdays and preferences, and show you care through details. In a team or among coworkers, you often listen and look after the mood. But you tend to carry other people's feelings too. Sort out what you can help with and what the other person has to face themselves, and you won't keep getting tired on others' behalf.
太陰|交友.strength: You have a few friends you can be honest with, and coworkers like working with you because you're easy to talk to and considerate, so the atmosphere is always harmonious.
太陰|交友.watch: When someone turns cold, you start wondering if you did something wrong. Don't rush to blame yourself. They may simply be busy, and it's fine to check in again in a couple of days.
太陰|交友.ask_next: Lately, with which friend or coworker do you feel a bit of distance?

太陰|官祿.title: Suited to careful, thoughtful work
太陰|官祿.plain: With Tai Yin in the Career Palace, you suit fields that need patience, care, and a sense of beauty, like design, planning, service, education, writing, or work related to home and daily life. You don't like to grab the spotlight, but you work steadily and with good quality, and in time you get noticed. Behind-the-scenes roles, or ones that need quiet focus, also suit you. Gather your results into a portfolio so others can see your value more easily, and more opportunities will come.
太陰|官祿.strength: Your work is detailed and warm. What you hand in rarely needs redoing because the details are covered, and clients and managers feel at ease leaving things to you.
太陰|官祿.watch: You don't push for yourself much, so others can easily take the credit. After finishing something important, remember to report your progress and results to your manager so your effort is seen.
太陰|官祿.ask_next: Right now, do you want to go deeper in your current work, or move into a field that suits you better?

太陰|田宅.title: Home is the harbor you care about most
太陰|田宅.plain: Your feelings for home run deep. With Tai Yin in the Property Palace, you like to make your living space warm and well made. You're interested in houses and living environments, and you may slowly build up property of your own. The mood at home affects your feelings a great deal, and you often have a deep bond with elders at home, especially on your mother's side. Put some thought into how home feels. A lamp or a good sofa can help you feel more at ease.
太陰|田宅.strength: Your home is warm and comfortable, your best place to recharge, and you relax as soon as you get back. You also have a good eye for choosing a home and judging a living environment.
太陰|田宅.watch: When there's an argument at home, your mood drops with it. First give yourself a corner where you can be alone, and once you've calmed down, go back and deal with it.
太陰|田宅.ask_next: Lately, what do you think about home: wanting to move, wanting a change, or wanting your family to get along better?

太陰|福德.title: A rich, sensitive inner world
太陰|福德.plain: With Tai Yin in the Well-being Palace, your inner life is delicate. You like quiet, beautiful things, like music, reading, and looking at a night view. Your moods swing more than they look from the outside, and you often work through them slowly on your own. You need time alone to recharge, and you find joy in small romantic moments. Set aside a regular quiet time for yourself, undisturbed, and your heart will be less likely to be pulled around by outside noise.
太陰|福德.strength: Your heart is soft and you can appreciate beauty in daily life. A song or a bit of moonlight can make you happy, and you comfort the people around you well.
太陰|福德.watch: When you feel low, it's easy to sink into it alone. Give yourself a time limit, and when it's up, go out for a walk or talk to someone.
太陰|福德.ask_next: Lately, are your mood swings mostly because of people, or because of matters to handle?

太陰|父母.title: Tender ties with elders
太陰|父母.plain: With Tai Yin in the Parents Palace, you have a deep emotional bond with your parents or elders, and you especially feel how hard they work. You may have been considerate from a young age and pay attention to elders' moods. The bosses you meet are also often gentler, willing to look after you and guide you. Show care through small everyday things, like a phone call or a meal together. Your bond deepens in the details, and you both feel freer to speak your minds.
太陰|父母.strength: Elders give you a lot of warmth and support, and your bosses see your effort. They're willing to guide and teach you, and give you direction and advice when you're stuck.
太陰|父母.watch: Caring too much about elders' expectations can lead you to wrong yourself. You can be considerate and also gently say what you think. The two don't conflict.
太陰|父母.ask_next: Lately, is there something you want to tell your parents but haven't said yet?

貪狼|命宮.title: Versatile and full of curiosity
貪狼|命宮.plain: With Tan Lang in the Life Palace, you're very curious and interested in many things. You learn fast and make friends easily. You have charm, get noticed in a crowd, and feel at home in social settings. You want a lot, you're full of enthusiasm for life, you like trying new things, and you often have several projects going at once. Pick one or two from your many interests and dig in seriously, so your talent becomes real ability. You'll go farther than you imagine.
貪狼|命宮.strength: You're well liked and full of ideas, and you can come up with fresh twists anywhere. Gatherings are less fun without you, and new opportunities often come knocking along with your connections.
貪狼|命宮.watch: Wanting everything, it's easy to do each thing only halfway. List the three things you most want to finish in this stretch, and set the rest aside for now.
貪狼|命宮.ask_next: Lately, what do you most want to put yourself into: a new interest, or a new relationship?

貪狼|兄弟.title: Both playmate and rival to your siblings
貪狼|兄弟.plain: With Tan Lang in the Siblings Palace, time with your siblings or close peers is lively. Sometimes they feel like playmates, and sometimes you compare yourselves to each other. Your interests may be very different, and each of you has your own circle. You often have someone around who takes you to new places and introduces you to new people. Doing fun things together, like trips or sports, brings you closer than sitting down to reason things out, and it helps small frictions pass more easily.
貪狼|兄弟.strength: Siblings and good friends bring you plenty of new information and fun. They often pull you out to see more of the world, and you may team up on something unexpected.
貪狼|兄弟.watch: Comparing yourselves can hurt the bond. Let each person's achievements shine on their own, and put your attention on things you can share and enjoy together.
貪狼|兄弟.ask_next: Lately, do you feel closer to your siblings or a little distant?

貪狼|夫妻.title: Freshness and heat in love
貪狼|夫妻.plain: In love, you need warmth and freshness. People with Tan Lang in the Spouse Palace like a partner who is fun, charming, and ready to play. You are easily drawn in, and you know how to put a spark into a relationship. But once things settle and days turn plain, you may start to feel something is missing.
