Find new shared interests with your partner, like learning something or visiting a place you have never been, so the warmth keeps going between you.
貪狼|夫妻.strength: Your life together is full of fun. You often try new restaurants, new places, and new things, and after many years you still feel drawn to each other.
貪狼|夫妻.watch: Temptation and ambiguity are all around you, so you need to draw your own lines clearly. If you care about how your partner feels, offer your plans before they ask, to put their mind at ease.
貪狼|夫妻.ask_next: Right now, are you more concerned with keeping the heat in your relationship, or with being sure of each other's feelings?

貪狼|子女.title: Easy like a friend to the younger ones
貪狼|子女.plain: With Tan Lang in the Children Palace, you are relaxed with your children, students, or younger people. You often play and learn together like friends. You introduce them to all kinds of new things and encourage them to try. Your creative work and talents are also read in this palace, and what you make often feels fresh and draws people in. Beyond play, help them see one or two things through to the end, so they learn perseverance as well as enthusiasm.
貪狼|子女.strength: Younger people find you fun and easy to talk to, and they are willing to tell you anything. You also see a new world through them, and you both grow.
貪狼|子女.watch: Being too easygoing can blur the rules. Set a few simple limits and follow through consistently. They will feel safer for it.
貪狼|子女.ask_next: Lately, is there something you want to nurture alongside your child, or do you want to help a younger person find direction?

貪狼|財帛.title: Many flexible ways to earn
貪狼|財帛.plain: When it comes to earning, you with Tan Lang in the Wealth Palace are flexible, and you often have more than one source of income. Networking, talents, or a side job can all open chances. You don't hold on to money tightly. It comes fast and goes fast, and you like spending on enjoyment and people. Friends often bring you opportunities. Set a fixed share of your income to save, put that aside first, then spend the rest on enjoyment. You can have fun and still have a cushion.
貪狼|財帛.strength: Your income comes in lively ways and your ideas can turn into earnings. Your connections and talents can open new paths, a hobby may become an income, and unexpected money often arrives.
貪狼|財帛.watch: Socializing and fun are where spending most easily goes over. Once a month, look through your expenses and cut the biggest overspend in half first.
貪狼|財帛.ask_next: Lately, do you want to add another source of income, or keep your spending in check?

貪狼|疾厄.title: Play hard, sleep well too
貪狼|疾厄.plain: With Tan Lang in the Health Palace, your energy is high and you enjoy activity and gatherings. Once you get busy, you often forget to rest. Social events and hobbies easily disrupt your routine, so late nights and irregular meals are common. When stress is high, you want to unwind with fun or food and drink. Set a few basic rhythms for yourself, like a regular wake-up time and fewer late nights on weekdays. Enjoy yourself and sleep well, and your energy will last longer.
貪狼|疾厄.strength: As long as you are willing to adjust, you find your good rhythm again quickly. Exercise and outdoor activities are also a great outlet for you, and a good sweat lifts your mood.
貪狼|疾厄.watch: After the buzz, you often get very tired. When planning your schedule, leave a gap between two gatherings so you can catch your breath and go to bed earlier.
貪狼|疾厄.ask_next: Of your recent daily habits, which one would you most like to change first?

貪狼|遷移.title: Going out opens a new world
貪狼|遷移.plain: With Tan Lang in the Travel Palace, you are full of energy as soon as you step out. You like traveling, business trips, and meeting new people. The world outside gives you a lot of stimulation and chances, and you often meet helpful people or find a new direction away from home. Work that takes you out and puts you in contact with people suits you well. But when you are having fun, it is easy to overspend and say yes too often. Before each trip, decide on its most important goal, so you gain something beyond fun.
貪狼|遷移.strength: You are well liked away from home and can talk with anyone. One trip can make new friends, and travel or business trips often bring back collaborations and fresh ideas.
貪狼|遷移.watch: Too many invitations can stretch you thin, and in the end you can't give any of them proper attention. Choose the ones that truly matter to you, and politely say "next time" to the rest.
貪狼|遷移.ask_next: Lately, do you want to go abroad, move to a new city, or look for new opportunities elsewhere?

貪狼|交友.title: Many friends, a wide and active circle
貪狼|交友.plain: With Tan Lang in the Friends Palace, your circle is wide, with people from all kinds of backgrounds, and you are often at gatherings and events. You lift the mood, and people like to invite you along. With coworkers, clients, and teams, you are good at spotting chances to work together. But with so many friends, some are inevitably just for fun. Tell apart the ones you can really talk with, and keep your sincerity for them.
貪狼|交友.strength: Your network is your resource. Many opportunities come through friends' introductions, deals come together easily, and people like to have you make connections.
貪狼|交友.watch: Being pulled by friends into things you're not good at, or agreeing to too much out of obligation, can wear you out. Learn to say, "I'll sit this one out."
貪狼|交友.ask_next: Lately, which relationship among the people around you do you most want to sort out?

貪狼|官祿.title: Suited to a varied, changing stage
貪狼|官祿.plain: At work, you need a stage and variety. With Tan Lang in the Career Palace, you suit sales, marketing, entertainment, design, food and beverage, public relations, or any field where you meet people and use creativity. You learn fast and dare to try new things, and you often wear several hats. Work that never changes drains your drive. Alongside a steady main job, leave some room for a side job or new project, so your passion has somewhere to go.
貪狼|官祿.strength: Your creativity and connections fill your work with opportunities. You can often turn a new idea into real results that make your boss and clients take notice.
貪狼|官祿.watch: With so many interests, you may switch paths often. Before switching, pause and ask yourself: am I trying to escape where I am, or do I really want to go there?
貪狼|官祿.ask_next: Right now, are you thinking of changing jobs, or of finding a new way to play in your current one?

貪狼|田宅.title: Make home a lively gathering place
貪狼|田宅.plain: With Tan Lang in the Property Palace, you like your home to feel alive, and you may often invite friends over for meals and gatherings. You have your own taste in decorating, like trying new styles, and may have moved several times. Your interest in houses and spaces changes with each stage of life. Divide your home into shared and private areas. When it's lively, everyone enjoys it, and when it's quiet, you still have a corner to rest and recharge.
貪狼|田宅.strength: Your home is warm and full of life, a place friends like to visit. You are good at shaping the feel of a space, and even a small place can have character.
貪狼|田宅.watch: A sudden impulse to move or renovate can push costs past what you expected. List your budget first, think it through, and compare prices before you act.
貪狼|田宅.ask_next: Lately, are you thinking of moving somewhere new, or of giving your home a new look?

貪狼|福德.title: Loving life and seeking enjoyment
貪狼|福德.plain: You know how to enjoy life. With Tan Lang in the Well-being Palace, good food, travel, music, and all kinds of fresh, fun things can bring you joy. Your interests are wide, and you may be curious about topics like spirituality and philosophy. There are often many wants in your heart, one after another. Beyond enjoyment, find one thing that quiets you down, like writing by hand or practicing a craft. Then the joy goes deeper and lasts longer.
貪狼|福德.strength: Your life is colorful, and you can always find ways to make yourself happy. When your mood dips, you get back up quickly on your own, and you are good at getting the people around you to play and laugh together.
貪狼|福德.watch: Always chasing new thrills can leave you feeling empty. Now and then, stop and sit quietly for a while, and ask yourself: what do I truly want right now?
貪狼|福德.ask_next: Lately, does your life feel like it's missing something, or is it packed too full?

貪狼|父母.title: Plenty to talk about, and some distance, with elders
貪狼|父母.plain: With Tan Lang in the Parents Palace, you and your parents or elders may have topics you enjoy talking about, but see lifestyle differently. They may be multi-talented or socially active, and they may influence you a good deal. The bosses you meet are often charming people with lots of ideas. Find a topic or activity you both like and spend more time together from there. The relationship will feel more natural, and you won't have to talk only about serious matters each time you meet.
貪狼|父母.strength: Elders and supervisors appreciate your flexibility and your way with people. They are willing to introduce you to more people, connect you with resources, and give you room to do things your way.
貪狼|父母.watch: When values differ, you can easily end up talking past each other. Don't rush to convince the other person. First find the part you can both accept, then talk through the rest slowly.
貪狼|父母.ask_next: Lately, is there something you'd like to reach common ground on with an elder or your boss?

巨門|命宮.title: Good at expressing yourself, and loves getting to the bottom of things
巨門|命宮.plain: With Ju Men in the Life Palace, you speak well and observe closely. You always want to get things clear, and you don't like glossing over them. You are sharp with information and often notice details others miss, which suits research, analysis, and teaching. You speak directly, and sometimes one sentence cuts to the point. Think more about timing and tone. The same view said a little more gently is easier for others to take in, and your insight will carry more influence.
巨門|命宮.strength: Your analysis and way of speaking are persuasive. However messy the situation, you can find the thread. On a team, you are the one who can explain complicated things clearly so everyone understands.
巨門|命宮.watch: Being too blunt or too suspicious can cause misunderstandings. Before you speak, ask yourself: is this sentence meant to solve a problem, or to vent a feeling?
巨門|命宮.ask_next: What do you most want to figure out lately: the truth of a situation, or what a certain person is thinking?

巨門|兄弟.title: Speak plainly with siblings
巨門|兄弟.plain: With Ju Men in the Siblings Palace, communication is where you put the most effort with your siblings or close peers. You may talk easily, and you may also argue over a single remark. Your views often differ, and when misunderstandings pile up, distance grows. When you work with close partners, spell out the division of tasks and the rules first. Make it a habit to speak face to face when something comes up, and avoid messages passed through a third person. Many knots then never form.
巨門|兄弟.strength: You can discuss things in depth, and the more you debate, the clearer it gets. You don't hold grudges after arguing. Siblings or good friends are often the best people to turn to when you face a hard problem.
巨門|兄弟.watch: Getting angry as soon as you hear a secondhand message is where trouble starts most easily. Ask the person directly what happened first, then decide how to respond.
巨門|兄弟.ask_next: Lately, is there something with a sibling that is still stuck in your heart?

巨門|夫妻.title: In love, communication is the key
巨門|夫妻.plain: In love, you value communication. With Ju Men in the Spouse Palace, you want your partner to talk with you in depth and understand what you're thinking. You two talk easily, and you can also argue over small things. You are sensitive to what your partner says, and one off tone can set you wondering. You could agree on a rule, like pausing for ten minutes during an argument before talking again, or setting aside a regular time each week to share what's on your mind, so that talking becomes a way to move closer.
巨門|夫妻.strength: You can talk about anything, from daily trivia to ideas about life. You understand each other best, and your hearts are closely connected.
巨門|夫妻.watch: Once suspicion starts, you may keep asking questions until your partner feels interrogated. Saying your own unease out loud works better than rapid-fire questions.
巨門|夫妻.ask_next: What is the one thing you most want to talk through with your partner right now?

巨門|子女.title: Put care into talking with the younger generation
巨門|子女.plain: With Ju Men in the Children Palace, you are willing to teach children, students, or younger people, and you like to reason things through with them. You notice details in how they speak and quickly spot when something is off. But when you say too much, they may hear only nagging. Your work and results often have depth, and you need to read them closely to see how good they are. Ask more questions and draw fewer conclusions. Let them say what they think, and communication will go much more smoothly.
巨門|子女.strength: In the eyes of the younger people, you are the best at answering questions. You explain clearly and sensibly, and give examples so they understand. When they are unsure, you are the first person they think of.
巨門|子女.watch: Constant correcting makes people not want to talk, and they may simply stop telling you anything. First name specifically what they did right, then raise just one thing to improve.
巨門|子女.ask_next: Lately, is there a sticking point in communication with your child or a younger person?

巨門|財帛.title: Earning through expertise and eloquence
巨門|財帛.plain: With Ju Men in the Wealth Palace, you often earn through your mouth and your mind, in things like teaching, consulting, sales, writing, explaining, or work that needs research and analysis. You are sensitive to price information and compare prices and look things up before you spend. But money matters can also cause trouble when communication is unclear. Write down every money-related agreement, such as profit sharing or when a loan will be repaid. With it in black and white, both sides can rest easy.
巨門|財帛.strength: Your expertise and eloquence are your earning power. When you explain things clearly, people are willing to pay. The more deeply you study a field, the better you understand it, and the steadier and more confident your income becomes.
巨門|財帛.watch: With partnerships or loans, the biggest worry is people telling different stories afterward. Spell out the amount and timing beforehand and write them down, and you'll avoid many disputes.
巨門|財帛.ask_next: Lately, with money matters, do you want to earn more, or is there an account you haven't settled clearly?

巨門|疾厄.title: Set worries down and your routine steadies
巨門|疾厄.plain: Your state is closely tied to whether you say what's on your mind. This is how Ju Men looks in the Health Palace. When things are bottled up or you can't make sense of them, your routine easily gets disrupted, and meals and sleep become irregular. You tend to think things over repeatedly, and under stress your mind won't stop. Find an outlet for yourself, like keeping a journal, talking with a friend, or exercising until you sweat. Pour your thoughts out, and the rhythm of your body and mind will return to normal.
巨門|疾厄.strength: You notice well when something is off in yourself. As long as you are willing to adjust, say what's on your mind, and set your routine in order, your energy and mood can settle quickly.
巨門|疾厄.watch: The more you think, the more tired you get. Give yourself a set "thinking time," like half an hour after dinner, and when time is up, go do something else.
巨門|疾厄.ask_next: Lately, what thought keeps you going once night comes?

巨門|遷移.title: Winning trust outside through expertise
巨門|遷移.plain: With Ju Men in the Travel Palace, what you rely on out in the world is expertise and the way you express yourself. People trust you because you know a lot and explain clearly. When you're out, you tend to observe first and ask around, and you don't open your heart right away. In crowds, gossip and quarrels come more easily, so mind your words. Focus on building real results and let them speak for you, and opportunities outside will come to you one by one.
巨門|遷移.strength: Away from home, you stand firm on a skill of your own. Speaking, teaching, or consulting often gets you noticed, and your name spreads by word of mouth, bit by bit.
巨門|遷移.watch: News you hear outside is half true and half false. Check before you pass it on, and don't rush to state a view or take a side, so you don't get pulled into other people's disputes.
巨門|遷移.ask_next: Lately, are you thinking of building something in another place, or have you run into trouble with people outside?

巨門|交友.title: Leave some room when talking among friends
巨門|交友.plain: In friendships you are more careful. With Ju Men in the Friends Palace, you don't trust people casually and need time to observe. You can talk with friends at real depth, but a difference of opinion can easily turn into an argument. Communication among coworkers, teams, and clients deserves extra attention from you. In a discussion, hear the other person's reasons through before you give your view, and leave each other some face. Working together goes much more smoothly, and the friendship lasts longer.
巨門|交友.strength: You have friends who can dig deep with you and spark new ideas in each other. A whole evening of talk never feels like too much. Coworkers value your opinion in meetings and often ask you to give things a final check.
巨門|交友.watch: Gossip behind people's backs does the most damage to relationships, and it's the most likely to find its way back to you. Don't join in and don't pass it on. Even when you hear it, set it aside, and if you have a question, ask the person directly.
巨門|交友.ask_next: Lately, is there anything among your friends or coworkers where you feel misunderstood?

巨門|官祿.title: Work that uses your voice and your mind
巨門|官祿.plain: With Ju Men in the Career Palace, you suit fields that call for communication, research, and analysis, such as education, legal work, consulting, media, sales, customer service, or any job built on explaining and persuading. You are good at finding the heart of a problem, and you dare to voice a different opinion. At work, though, speaking bluntly can sometimes upset people. If you frame criticism as a suggestion and name the strengths before the problems, your expertise will be accepted more easily.
巨門|官祿.strength: Your analytical ability and the way you express yourself give you real weight at work. Your reports are clear, your presentations are persuasive, and when people hit a hard problem, they come to you first.
巨門|官祿.watch: When you disagree with a boss or coworker, don't argue it out in public. Talk privately and bring a concrete proposal. You're more likely to be heard that way.
巨門|官祿.ask_next: In your current work, what do you most want to say but haven't said yet?

巨門|田宅.title: Say things well at home
巨門|田宅.plain: With Ju Men in the Property Palace, how people communicate at home has a big effect on your mood. Family members may talk easily with each other, and may also argue over small things. You care about details in your living space and like it quiet and private. For things like a house or a lease, read the documents and terms closely. Build a habit of speaking kindly at home, such as not raising upsetting topics at meals, and home becomes a place where you can truly rest.
巨門|田宅.strength: When the mood at home is harmonious, everyone can bring things up, talk them out, and let them go. You also handle the many details of daily living thoroughly and clearly.
巨門|田宅.watch: When signing a lease or buying or selling a home, the biggest risk is a verbal agreement that was never written down clearly. Read every clause, ask about it, and sign only when you have no doubts.
巨門|田宅.ask_next: With things at home lately, is the issue where you live, or the communication between family members?

巨門|福德.title: Deep-thinking, always thinking and asking
巨門|福德.plain: Your mind rarely rests. With Ju Men in the Well-being Palace, you like to think and research, and you always want to ask why. Your inner world is deep, and there is often much you leave unsaid. You may also be especially drawn to topics like knowledge, philosophy, and psychology. But when you think too much, you can slip into worry. Turn thinking into learning, such as reading and writing down your thoughts, so your mind has a positive outlet, and it is easier for your heart to settle.
巨門|福德.strength: You are insightful and can see principles in daily life that others miss. Often a single remark of yours wakes a friend up. When your thinking comes together, you feel deeply fulfilled too.
巨門|福德.watch: Thoughts spiraling toward the worst is where you most often get stuck. When you notice you're going in circles, get up, pour a glass of water, and do something else.
巨門|福德.ask_next: Lately, what is the "why" that keeps coming up in your mind?

巨門|父母.title: Talk more with elders
巨門|父母.plain: With Ju Men in the Parents Palace, communication with your parents or elders is where you most need to put care. You may see things differently, and a talk can easily turn into a fight, or you each fall silent halfway through. When a boss gives instructions, you also tend to ask about the reasons first. Choose a time when the other person is in a good mood to discuss important things, and listen fully before you speak. When they feel you want to communicate, not to win, the relationship grows closer with each talk.
巨門|父母.strength: Elders or bosses value your opinion. You can discuss things on their merits, each giving your reasons without hurting feelings, and both sides gain something.
巨門|父母.watch: If you say something too harshly, an elder may remember it for a long time and be hurt. If you really got it wrong, simply say you're sorry, and the relationship can recover quickly.
巨門|父母.ask_next: Lately, with an elder or boss, what do you most want to make clear?

天相|命宮.title: Someone who coordinates well and values good judgment
天相|命宮.plain: People with Tian Xiang in the Life Palace usually give a first impression of being steady and poised. You speak with measure and care about how things look. You naturally think of others and are often the one in a group who coordinates and wraps things up. When you decide, you tend to look first at what the people around you think, and the state of your companions often directly affects how you perform. Find the right people to work with, and your strengths are magnified.
天相|命宮.strength: At your best, you are fair and reliable. People are glad to hand you important matters, and you handle them thoroughly, which puts them at ease. Even when something unexpected happens, you can hold the situation steady.
天相|命宮.watch: You often get stuck on too many concerns and feeling awkward about saying no. When you can't decide, first write down what you truly want, then ask others for their opinions.
天相|命宮.ask_next: Lately, what is the hardest thing to say no to, and to whom?

天相|兄弟.title: The peacemaker among siblings and peers
天相|兄弟.plain: With Tian Xiang in the Siblings Palace, you often play the mediator among your siblings and close peers. When two people are at odds, it's usually you who steps in to smooth things over. You care that everyone gets along decently, and you are willing to help when someone needs it. This caring energy is real, but sometimes you take on so much that your own matters get pushed to the back. Remember you can ask them for help too, so the relationship goes both ways.
天相|兄弟.strength: When relationships are good, you and your peers support each other and carry things together. Because people like you, you often get practical help in return. Everyone remembers your kindness.
天相|兄弟.watch: Worrying too much about other people's affairs is your most common kind of tiredness. Before helping, ask, "How far do you need me to go?" Clear boundaries make it easier for both of you.
天相|兄弟.ask_next: Right now, which relationship with a peer feels like it most needs a good talk?

天相|夫妻.title: In love, you value respect and an easy understanding
天相|夫妻.plain: With Tian Xiang in the Spouse Palace, what you expect from a partner is often "respect for each other and a sense of measure in how we live together." You like a stable, dignified relationship and are willing to look after your partner in the details of daily life. You care how the two of you appear in front of others, and also whether your partner truly understands you. When you disagree, you tend to hold back and keep the peace, and speak only after it has piled up. In fact, your partner also wants to hear what you really think.
天相|夫妻.strength: When you two understand each other well, you are a very good partner: considerate and dependable, arranging your days in an orderly way together and backing each other up.
天相|夫妻.watch: Swallowing hurt feelings and leaving your partner to guess is where you most easily get stuck. Say small things in the moment, starting with "I feel," which is easier to talk about than settling everything at once later.
天相|夫妻.ask_next: In this relationship, what do you most want your partner to know but haven't said yet?

天相|子女.title: Accompany the next generation's growth with patience
天相|子女.plain: With Tian Xiang in the Children Palace, when you are with children, younger people, or newcomers you mentor, you care about rules and courtesy and are willing to take time to explain things clearly. You hope they grow up sensible and well-mannered, so you watch the details. This palace also reflects what you make with your own hands. Your work is usually meticulous, holds up under close inspection, and often puts collaborators at ease. You teach gently, and younger people are usually glad to be close to you.
天相|子女.strength: When younger people trust you and are willing to listen, the people you bring up and the work you produce often feel carefully made and well crafted. They are also willing to keep learning from you.
天相|子女.watch: If you demand too much on details, the other person may feel suffocated. Now and then, praise what's already been done first, then talk about what to adjust.
天相|子女.ask_next: Right now, which younger person or piece of work worries you most? Where does it get stuck?

天相|財帛.title: Steady with money, and keen on order
天相|財帛.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Wealth Palace, your attitude toward money tends to be steady and step by step. Your income mostly comes from your expertise, your position, or looking after things for other people. You like to spend with some dignity and won't skimp where it counts, but you also remember to set something aside for your own peace of mind. You do well when you keep your income and spending clear and set rules of your own, and you may find you have more room than you expected. The simpler and more transparent your sources of income are, the better you sleep and the more comfortably you can plan your next step.
天相|財帛.strength: When things are going well, your income is steady and your books are clear. People feel safe leaving money matters with you, and your credit is good. The longer you go, the more people come to you offering to work together.
天相|財帛.watch: Spending extra for the sake of appearances or social obligation is what you most need to watch. Before a big purchase, sleep on it and ask yourself whether it's for a need or just to look good.
天相|財帛.ask_next: Which recent expense keeps making you wonder whether it was really worth it?

天相|疾厄.title: A regular routine steadies you most
天相|疾厄.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Health Palace, the focus is your daily rhythm, stress, and pace of life. You like regularity, and when your routine gets disrupted, your mood and energy tend to wobble too. You're used to holding things up for others and often hide your tiredness until you're already worn out. Setting aside a fixed stretch of rest for yourself matters more than anything else. You relax most easily in a quiet, tidy space, and planning tomorrow before bed can help you sleep more soundly.
天相|疾厄.strength: When your pace is steady, you feel energetic and organized, and you can look after the people around you without it feeling like a strain. Getting things done feels much lighter, too.
天相|疾厄.watch: Pushing through until you finally rest is your old habit. Each week, set aside a block of time when you have nothing to do. Put it in your schedule first, then fit everything else around it.
天相|疾厄.ask_next: Lately, what has thrown your routine off the most?

天相|遷移.title: You tend to meet helpers when you're out in the world
天相|遷移.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Travel Palace, you tend to be noticed once you step outside and into new surroundings. In unfamiliar settings you read people well, find your place quickly, and others are willing to give you chances. Business trips, a change of environment, and dealings with people from other places often bring new collaborations. You make a good impression out there, so remember to save some energy for home and for yourself. People you meet away from home often become important helpers a few years later.
天相|遷移.strength: When you're out and about, you're well liked and well regarded, often recommended and introduced to others, and things usually go smoothly. Many of your opportunities come from outside.
天相|遷移.watch: Caring too much about how outsiders see you can leave you tired once you're home. In the middle of a busy outing, leave a gap to catch your breath. You don't have to stay to the very end of every event.
天相|遷移.ask_next: If you had the chance to change your surroundings, where would you most like to go, and what would you do there?

天相|交友.title: A dependable coordinator in your circle of friends
天相|交友.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Friends Palace, you value character and good manners in friendships, and your circle is mostly people who keep their word and are comfortable to be around. When everyone gets together, you're often the one who organizes things and looks after each person's feelings. You also tend to meet friends who are willing to help you, though you're not used to asking. Many people remember the kindness you give. When friends ask for your help, you always do your best, and that reliability keeps your friendships long-lasting.
天相|交友.strength: Friends are willing to speak up for you and make introductions. You have a good reputation in groups, and what you want to do often has support. When you need hands, there's always a friend who shows up.
天相|交友.watch: Looking after everyone while no one looks after you is easy for you to overlook. Next time you need help, say so directly. Your friends will be happier to help than you think.
天相|交友.ask_next: Is there a friend you've long wanted to ask for help but haven't spoken up to?

天相|官祿.title: Well suited to management and coordination roles
天相|官祿.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Career Palace, you suit work that calls for trust and coordination, such as management, administration, consulting, or being the outside point of contact. You're careful and follow the rules, and what's handed to you gets handled properly. You care about your title and the dignity of your work, and about what your boss and colleagues think. A good team brings out your best. You'd also make a fine right hand to a manager, checking details and organizing progress for the whole team.
天相|官祿.strength: On a team, you're the one people feel at ease with. Your manager trusts you, colleagues like working with you, and promotions mostly come steadily. The trust you've built up is your capital.
天相|官祿.watch: Not speaking up for yourself because you're afraid of offending someone is where you tend to get stuck at work. Before negotiating, organize your results and let the facts speak for you.
天相|官祿.ask_next: In your current job, what do you most want to go after but are still hesitating over?

天相|田宅.title: You value order and decorum at home
天相|田宅.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Property Palace, you care a lot about your living space. You like your home tidy and comfortable, so that guests can visit without any embarrassment. You feel deeply about home, put thought into arranging it, and are glad to take care of the big and small matters for your family. You settle your mind best in an orderly space, and even keep your desk neat and clean. When it comes to decisions about where to live or whether to move, you usually think things through thoroughly. For you, once home is in order, your heart settles too.
天相|田宅.strength: When the mood at home is harmonious, you can truly relax, and you're able to gradually make your living space better and better. Your family also loves being in the space you take care of.
天相|田宅.watch: You often shoulder everything at home. Try sharing chores and decisions with your family, and you'll feel much lighter. Not everything has to be settled by you.
天相|田宅.ask_next: For you, what's the one thing you most want to change about where you live now?

天相|福德.title: Inwardly seeking balance and stability
天相|福德.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Well-being Palace, what you long for most inside is balance and stability, with everything in its proper place. You like a life with taste: eating well, dressing nicely, and talking with people who understand. You easily take responsibility for other people's feelings, and when others are unhappy, you feel uneasy too. Learning to tell which feelings are really yours will let you feel more at ease. You also need some enjoyment that belongs only to you, like a good meal or a quiet stretch of time.
天相|福德.strength: When your heart is settled, you know how to enjoy life, your emotions are steady, and the people around you feel cared for and relaxed. Your gentleness is soothing in itself.
天相|福德.watch: Carrying other people's moods on yourself wears you out. When you feel bothered, first ask yourself: is this mine, or someone else's?
天相|福德.ask_next: Lately, what lets you truly relax and think about nothing at all?

天相|父母.title: Courtesy matters in your dealings with elders
天相|父母.plain: With Tian Xiang (a main star) in the Parents Palace, your relationships with your parents, elders, and bosses tend to be marked by courtesy and a sense of propriety. You know how to respect those above you, and that often earns you care or a promotion. You're a bit reserved around elders and don't quite dare say some things from the heart. With formal documents like contracts and applications, you're usually careful and rarely make mistakes. In fact, elders mostly want to hear what's on your mind, but neither side knows where to begin.
天相|父母.strength: Elders and bosses appreciate your good manners and are willing to teach you and give you a hand, and you handle formal occasions well. Many important doors were opened for you by elders.
天相|父母.watch: Swallowing your words in front of elders creates distance over time. Pick a relaxed moment and start by sharing small things, and gradually you'll be able to say more.
天相|父母.ask_next: Is there something you've long wanted to say to an elder or a boss?

天梁|命宮.title: Looking after people like an older brother or sister
天梁|命宮.plain: People with Tian Liang (a main star) in the Life Palace often come across as mature and dependable, like an older sibling even at a young age. You have your own principles, like to look at things for the long term, and are glad to offer ideas and give people a hand. When a problem comes up, you're often the calmest one, and people in trouble tend to come to you first. You may sometimes find yourself wanting to take care of everyone without noticing. Your reliability builds up slowly, and the longer it goes, the more people are willing to listen to you.
天梁|命宮.strength: You're steady and knowledgeable, and your words carry weight. People naturally trust and rely on you, and when something happens they want to hear from you first.
天梁|命宮.watch: If you can't help giving advice, the other person may feel lectured. Ask first, "Would you like to hear my view?" and they'll be more open to it.
天梁|命宮.ask_next: Who have you been worrying about lately? What do you yourself really care about in that situation?

天梁|兄弟.title: Being the one your peers lean on
天梁|兄弟.plain: Tian Liang in the Siblings Palace: among your siblings and peers, you are often the one people lean on. They tend to come to you first when something comes up, and you are glad to step in and handle it. You feel responsible toward your peers, and when you see them drifting off course, you can't help speaking up. That care is precious. Sometimes, though, you treat them as people who need looking after and forget they have their own judgment. Trusting them at the right moment and letting them walk their own way is also a form of care.
天梁|兄弟.strength: Your peers trust you and are willing to hear your opinion. You can help each other at the key moments, and the bond grows steadier over time. Your peers often keep you in their hearts because of this.
天梁|兄弟.watch: If you manage too much, the other person may feel looked down on. Give your opinion, then let go and let them decide. The relationship will last longer. They can feel your support.
天梁|兄弟.ask_next: Is there a peer right now you really want to help but worry about overstepping with?

天梁|夫妻.title: Likes a mature partner who looks after you in return
天梁|夫妻.plain: Tian Liang in the Spouse Palace: in love, you prefer a mature partner who takes responsibility, or you often play the caring role yourself. Trust and responsibility matter a lot to you, and being together means supporting each other. You are easily drawn to someone older and steady, and you may act like a half-elder in the relationship, thinking and reminding a lot on your partner's behalf. At your best, you can both rely on each other and are both willing to let the other lean on you for a while.
天梁|夫妻.strength: You support each other like teammates and can talk things through when something comes up. The longer you are together, the more grounded and secure the bond feels. In big moments, you are each other's backing.
天梁|夫妻.watch: The most common misunderstanding is when care comes out as correction. When you want to remind your partner of something, say your worry first and the suggestion second. The tone will soften a lot.
天梁|夫妻.ask_next: In this relationship, are you more often the one who cares for others, or the one being cared for?

天梁|子女.title: Devoted to younger people the way a teacher is
天梁|子女.plain: Tian Liang in the Children Palace: with children, younger people or students, you are often as devoted as a teacher, willing to teach and willing to wait. You want them to learn how to live and work well, so you take time to explain why. Your work usually has substance and holds up over time, and you keep your word when you work with others. Your expectations of younger people are high, but they come from wanting the best for them. People you have taught often come back years later to thank you for your reminders.
天梁|子女.strength: Younger people respect you and keep your words in mind. The people you bring up often have a solid foundation and walk steadily. Years later, they still remember the care you gave.
天梁|子女.watch: If you explain too much, people stop listening. Try listening more and talking less: ask what they think first, then add your experience. They will be more willing to come close to you.
天梁|子女.ask_next: What is the one lesson you most want to pass on to younger people? Have they taken it in?

天梁|財帛.title: Earns income through expertise and experience
天梁|財帛.plain: Tian Liang in the Wealth Palace: you mostly earn through expertise, experience and trustworthiness, and you suit work where people need to trust you, such as consulting, teaching or professional services. Your view of money leans steady, and you dislike very risky approaches. You are also happy to spend on others: treating friends, helping out, looking after family. Money is more like a tool for security and for caring for people. Your income usually grows steadier over time, and the more experience you have, the more your value rises.
天梁|財帛.strength: When your expertise is valued, income is steady. Elders or helpful people often introduce opportunities, and money comes in on solid ground. Your reputation is your best sign on the door.
天梁|財帛.watch: When you soften, money lent or spent may never come back. Before helping, work out how much you can afford, then say yes. Helping for the long run matters more than helping a lot.
天梁|財帛.ask_next: Right now, is the balance between what you spend on others and what you spend on yourself comfortable?

天梁|疾厄.title: Feels lighter when you can set worries down
天梁|疾厄.plain: Tian Liang in the Health Palace is read here as your daily rhythm, stress and pace. You are used to worrying for others, and other people's matters often weigh on your mind, so your stress mostly comes from your sense of responsibility. Your fatigue builds up slowly and doesn't show right away, so you need a regular rest rhythm even more. Write down the worries, leave them for tomorrow, and let your mind power down before sleep. Slower ways of unwinding suit you, like a walk, a cup of tea, or a chat with an old friend.
天梁|疾厄.strength: Good recovery is your strength. The busier it gets, the calmer you are, and you can use past experience to adjust your pace. Under pressure, you rarely lose your footing.
天梁|疾厄.watch: Taking other people's troubles to bed drains you most. For the hour before sleep, don't answer messages or handle others' matters, and let yourself truly clock out.
天梁|疾厄.ask_next: What worry have you most often carried to bed lately? Does it really need your thinking tonight?

天梁|遷移.title: Meets elders who lift you up when away from home
天梁|遷移.plain: Tian Liang in the Travel Palace: when you go out into the world, away from familiar surroundings, you often meet elders or seniors who are willing to help. Outside, you come across as reliable and knowledgeable, and people want your opinion when they have problems. Business trips, travel or a change of setting are often good chances for you to broaden your view. You look after people a lot out there, so remember you can be looked after too. The farther you go, the more you see how much your accumulated experience is worth.
天梁|遷移.strength: You have a good name outside, and people often offer introductions and chances on their own. When you go out to get things done, you easily meet people willing to help. You are often more popular away from home than in your hometown.
天梁|遷移.watch: Taking on things that aren't yours when you're out will leave you tired later. When someone asks for help, check your time first, then decide how much to give.
天梁|遷移.ask_next: If there were a chance to build something somewhere far away right now, would you want to grab it?

天梁|交友.title: Friends often treat you as someone to lean on
天梁|交友.plain: Tian Liang in the Friends Palace: your circle often includes people older or more mature than you, and you are often the one friends turn to for advice. You value loyalty in friendship, and when a friend is in trouble, you step up to help. You like friendships with depth and aren't keen on surface socializing. You give your friends a lot of care and deserve to be cherished the same way. Your friendships often last many years, getting richer with time, and you understand each other better and better.
天梁|交友.strength: Friends point each other in the right direction. You gain experience and opportunities from them, and your network grows steadier. Old friends are often your strongest support.
天梁|交友.watch: Being everyone's advisor while having no one to talk to yourself is a gap you easily overlook. Pick one or two friends you trust and let them hear your worries too.
天梁|交友.ask_next: When was the last time you told a friend about your own worries?

天梁|官祿.title: Suits work that needs trust and expertise
天梁|官祿.plain: Tian Liang in the Career Palace: at work, you suit roles that call for professional judgment and trust, such as education, consulting, public service, review or quality control. You go by principle and dislike shortcuts, and your managers value your steadiness. You are often the person colleagues ask for advice, and the more senior you become, the more you shine and the more weight you carry. You also suit leading people, and newcomers who follow you often learn solid ways of working.
天梁|官祿.strength: Your expertise and character are recognized, your words carry weight at work, and you are often placed in important gatekeeping positions. The more senior you are, the more you are relied on.
天梁|官祿.watch: You can't stand things that break the rules, which can cause friction. First separate principle from habit; not everything needs to be held to the end.
天梁|官祿.ask_next: In your current work, which of your abilities do you most want recognized?

天梁|田宅.title: Home is the haven that lets you feel at ease
天梁|田宅.plain: Tian Liang in the Property Palace: you feel deeply responsible for home and are often the one who makes decisions and looks after everyone. You like a settled place to live, perhaps one with some history, and you care for your family thoroughly. The same goes for your workplace: a stable, orderly environment helps you focus best. With decisions about where you live, you tend to think long term and don't change easily. Home is not just a place to stay; it is where you and your family look after each other.
天梁|田宅.strength: Your family trusts you, the atmosphere at home is calm, and you can easily get elders' support with housing or family matters. Home is where you relax and recharge best.
天梁|田宅.watch: Taking on every little thing at home can leave you out of breath. Try letting family members share the tasks, so you don't have to check on everything yourself. You may find everyone can manage.
天梁|田宅.ask_next: What is the most important condition of your ideal home? Do you have it now?

天梁|福德.title: Mature inside, likes to think about life
天梁|福德.plain: With Tian Liang in the Well-being Palace, you are inwardly mature. You often think about the reasons behind life, and you like reading, hearing other people's stories, or studying things with depth. When things get hard, you can usually think your way through on your own, slowly. You worry easily for others, and there is more going on inside you than shows on the outside. Give yourself a little time alone and you find your calm again quickly. Your calm isn't something you were born with. It has built up each time you worked something through.
天梁|福德.strength: You see things clearly and your moods are steady. You can comfort the people around you with your own experience, and they feel at ease with you. Your company carries weight.
天梁|福德.watch: Overthinking and worrying about things that haven't happened can cost you sleep. Write your worries down, sort them into what you can act on and what you can't, and do the first group first.
天梁|福德.ask_next: Is there something lately that you keep turning over and still can't make sense of?

七殺|交友.plain: With Qi Sha in the Friends Palace, you don't need a big circle. You prefer people who are genuine and speak plainly. Your friends each have their own personality, and you may argue when you disagree, but you're still good friends afterward. In your circle you tend to meet driven people, and working together with them is efficient. You value loyalty, you step in when a friend needs you, and you hope they treat you sincerely in return. You may not have many friends, but each one has stood the test and can walk a long road with you.
七殺|交友.strength: Your friends push each other forward, and you can often build something real together. The bond is solid. When things get hard, your friends stand by you to the end.
七殺|交友.watch: One sharp sentence can spark a conflict with a friend that is hard to repair afterward. When you argue, talk about the issue, not the person, and the relationship is easier to mend. After a fight, be the one to speak first and make up.
七殺|交友.ask_next: Which friend around you pushes you forward the most?
七殺|交友.title: Few friends, but close, and sincerity matters

七殺|官祿.title: Suited to pioneering and challenging work
七殺|官祿.plain: With Qi Sha in the Career Palace, you need a workplace with challenges and clear goals. Too much comfort and stability can leave you flat. You suit pioneering roles such as sales, project lead, a new department, or starting your own business. Your career may have a few clear turns, and each one teaches you new skills. You work fast and value efficiency, so leading the charge suits you. You need a manager who lets you run with things. Give you room and you deliver results.
七殺|官祿.strength: You execute well and take on hard problems, and you can often produce clear results in a short time that others notice. You're also often sent to open up new ground.
七殺|官祿.watch: When you want to move fast, you can clash with people who work at a slower pace. Before pushing something forward, take a little time to align on direction, and the road ahead goes more smoothly.
七殺|官祿.ask_next: At work, which goal do you most want to take on right now?

七殺|田宅.title: Living situation shifts with life stages
七殺|田宅.plain: With Qi Sha in the Property Palace, your living situation often changes with your life stage. Moving or changing where you live is nothing new to you. You like a space where you make the decisions and don't enjoy being told how to live. You tend to decide household matters yourself, and quickly. When your work environment changes, you actually find it fresh and feel more motivated. Where you live often reflects the stage you're in, and each move means you're stepping toward the next one.
七殺|田宅.strength: You can shape a home you like through your own effort, and each change makes your life more like what you want. Your home is your base.
七殺|田宅.watch: Deciding to move or change on impulse often leaves you with a lot of catching up afterward. For important decisions about where to live, give yourself a period of observation before you decide.
七殺|田宅.ask_next: If you could change where you live right now, what would you most want to change?

七殺|福德.title: An inner drive that won't stop
七殺|福德.plain: With Qi Sha in the Well-being Palace, you have an inner drive that won't stop, always thinking about the next step. You enjoy challenges and the feeling of reaching a goal, and you feel a bit uneasy when you're idle. Your emotions come out directly, and whether you're happy or not shows on your face. Learn to leave a little blank space in your busy days and simply enjoy the moment, and you'll find yourself more settled inside. Your happiness often comes at the moment you finish something, so remember to celebrate for yourself too.
七殺|福德.strength: Your goals are clear and your will is firm. When you hit difficulty, you can adjust your mindset quickly and keep going. People around you admire this resilience.
七殺|福德.watch: Being too strict with yourself can make rest feel like wasted time. Try treating rest as a goal too, and complete it seriously. When you're well rested, you can run farther.
七殺|福德.ask_next: Lately, what has let you truly stop and enjoy the moment?

七殺|父母.title: Your own views with elders
七殺|父母.plain: With Qi Sha in the Parents Palace, you and your parents, elders, and bosses often each hold your own views, and the way you relate is fairly direct. You don't like being managed. You prefer to figure things out and decide for yourself. Elders may expect a lot from you and be rather strict, but their intention is mostly that you become independent. Faced with rules, you tend to find your own way within the framework. Your relationship with elders often gets better once you are truly independent.
七殺|父母.strength: You and your elders respect each other. They appreciate your independence, and you learn real skills from their strictness. Each of you finds the other reliable.
七殺|父母.watch: Clashing head-on with elders wears both sides out. When you disagree, first say you understand their worry, then share your plan. They'll feel more at ease letting you go ahead.
七殺|父母.ask_next: What do you and your elders most often disagree about?

破軍|命宮.title: Bold enough to break old patterns and open new paths
破軍|命宮.plain: People with Po Jun in the Life Palace carry an energy that seeks the new and welcomes change. You don't like keeping things as they were, and when you see something unreasonable you want to change it. You're often the first to say, "Let's try a different way." Your life often has a few major turns, each one like a fresh restart. You dare to let go and dare to begin again, and that courage takes you farther than most. You're often most alive at the moment everything starts over.
破軍|命宮.strength: You have initiative and drive, and you can see new possibilities in old things and bring the people around you along in changing. Many new beginnings were started by you first.
破軍|命宮.watch: Tearing down what exists before you've thought it through is what you most need to watch. Before you act, decide what you'll build next. That way the change leaves something lasting.
破軍|命宮.ask_next: Which part of your life do you most want to tear down and rebuild right now?

破軍|兄弟.title: Relationships with peers often shift
破軍|兄弟.plain: With Po Jun in the Siblings Palace, your relationships with siblings and peers often change as life stages change. Sometimes you're close, sometimes each of you is busy with your own life, and the way you interact keeps adjusting. Among your peers you're often the one with new ideas, and you like leading everyone to try things they haven't done. When you work together, state each other's expectations first, and this change can become momentum. Your relationships aren't afraid of change. What hurts is walking away without saying things clearly.
破軍|兄弟.strength: You and your peers open up new ground together, spark many ideas off each other, and what you do is fresh and fun. Working together often brings unexpected rewards.
破軍|兄弟.watch: Changing direction midway through a joint effort can leave others behind. Before adjusting, explain the reason to everyone first. They'll be more willing to follow your change.
破軍|兄弟.ask_next: Which peer would you most like to do something with that neither of you has ever done?

破軍|夫妻.title: Enjoys freshness and growth in love
破軍|夫妻.plain: With Po Jun in the Spouse Palace, you enjoy freshness in love, and you like growing and changing together as a couple. You're easily drawn to people with personality who don't play by the rules. Change in a relationship feels normal to you, and every stage may call for adjusting how you get along. When you both face change together, the relationship gains depth. For you, a good relationship isn't one that stays the same, but one where two people become better together.
破軍|夫妻.strength: You often try new things together, so life has variety and surprises, and the relationship is full of energy. You grow together and find more to talk about as you go.
破軍|夫妻.watch: Assuming something has gone wrong as soon as things feel plain is an easy mistake for you. Try bringing in a little something new yourself rather than rushing to replace what you have.
破軍|夫妻.ask_next: What new thing would you like to try together in this relationship next?

破軍|子女.title: Trying new things with the younger generation
破軍|子女.plain: With Po Jun in the Children Palace, when you're with children, younger people, or newcomers you mentor, you encourage them to try and not fear mistakes. The people you raise often have their own ideas and dare to take a different path. Your creative work and collaborations often break convention in ways that catch the eye. You love new projects and often start one after another. You have plenty of ideas, and younger people are often carried along by your enthusiasm and willing to try with you. The teams you've led are often the most willing to innovate.
破軍|子女.strength: You can spark creativity in younger people, and what you do together often breaks new ground and leaves an impression. Everyone remembers those days of venturing out together.
破軍|子女.watch: You start many things and finish none. Pick the most important project and complete it first, then start the next. Finishing one feels more rewarding than starting ten.
破軍|子女.ask_next: Of the projects you've started but not finished, which one do you most want to complete first?

破軍|財帛.title: Income that rises and falls with change, bold in earning and spending
破軍|財帛.plain: With Po Jun in the Wealth Palace, you are bold about both earning and spending, and you dare to look for opportunities in new fields. Your income may rise and fall as your work changes, and new income often arrives only after you switch tracks. You spend freely too: when you see something you like or want to try, you go for it. Building steady habits for tracking expenses and saving can give your changes more footing. You are flexible about money and know how to trade it for experience and opportunity.
破軍|財帛.strength: You can open up income from new directions. You dare to spend and dare to earn, and you often get better returns after changing tracks. Your boldness often brings new income.
破軍|財帛.watch: Money often goes faster than you expect. Each month, set aside what you want to save first, then arrange the rest freely. Keep a reserve for unexpected expenses too.
破軍|財帛.ask_next: Lately, which new thing do you most want to spend money on? Why?

天梁|父母.title: Deep ties with elders, often looked after
天梁|父母.plain: With Tian Liang in the Parents Palace, your bond with your parents and elders is usually deep, and they often look after you and guide you. You also tend to meet bosses or seniors who are willing to back you. But elders' care can sometimes turn into a lot of opinions, and that may feel like pressure. When you deal with systems and rules, you usually stay composed, so formal matters are safe in your hands. With elders, you do best when you treat their experience as a reference, not an order.
天梁|父母.strength: Your elders are your backing. Your boss is willing to teach you and give you chances, and at key moments someone often lends you a hand. This bond is worth treasuring.
天梁|父母.watch: Being tied down by elders' expectations is what you most need to loosen. After you hear their views, remember to ask yourself what you truly want, then choose.
天梁|父母.ask_next: Which piece of advice from an elder lately has left you most unsure?

七殺|命宮.title: A person of strong drive who dares to charge ahead
七殺|命宮.plain: People with Qi Sha in the Life Palace carry an energy that pushes forward. You act decisively, move as soon as you think of something, dislike dragging things out, and challenges tend to energize you. You have your own pace and direction, and you don't much like being arranged by others. Your life often has a few big turns, and each one was your own choice. Put this force in the right place and you can open a road of your own. You are often most alive when facing something everyone else thinks is very hard.
七殺|命宮.strength: You have boldness and strong follow-through. You get moving while others hesitate and bring people along, and you are especially dependable at critical moments.
七殺|命宮.watch: Deciding too fast can leave others behind. On important matters, pause first and explain your reasons to the people around you. There will be far less resistance.
七殺|命宮.ask_next: What is one thing you really want to start on right now?

七殺|兄弟.title: Strong views on both sides with your peers
七殺|兄弟.plain: With Qi Sha in the Siblings Palace, you and your siblings and peers often each hold strong views, and you deal with each other directly. You may not stick close together, but when something big happens, you step in for each other. Among your peers you tend to take the lead, and you like everyone doing their own thing without interference. When you work together, spell out who does what, and you bring out the best in each other. Your closeness doesn't rest on daily contact but on a word at the right moment.
七殺|兄弟.strength: You and your peers are like comrades-in-arms. Each has real ability, you admire each other, you work efficiently together, and you don't back down in hard times. You are each other's confidence.
七殺|兄弟.watch: If you speak too bluntly, the other person may find it harsh. When you disagree, first acknowledge where they are coming from, then share your view. They will be more willing to keep listening.
七殺|兄弟.ask_next: With which peer is there something lately that has been stuck and left unsaid?

七殺|夫妻.title: In love, you each need your own space
七殺|夫妻.plain: With Qi Sha in the Spouse Palace, you like partners with personality and views of their own. Being together has sparks and plenty of discussion. You are focused when you commit, but you also need your own space and pace. Change in a relationship is normal to you, and you go through adjusting and finding your rhythm again together. When you say clearly what you need, the relationship grows steadier. You need a partner who can keep up with your pace and dares to tell you the truth.
七殺|夫妻.strength: You motivate each other like partners, take on new goals together, and the relationship is lively and rarely dull. Walking forward together, you grow more in tune.
七殺|夫妻.watch: Clashing head-on when you disagree is the moment most likely to hurt the relationship. Agree on a way to pause before emotions rise, then come back and talk once you've cooled down.
七殺|夫妻.ask_next: In this relationship, what do you most need from your partner: space or support?

七殺|子女.title: Direct and lively with the younger generation
七殺|子女.plain: With Qi Sha in the Children Palace, when you are with your children, younger people, or newcomers you mentor, your style is direct and values action and results. The people you bring up are usually independent and driven, and willing to strike out on their own. The younger ones may also have strong views and, like you, dislike being arranged. The work or collaborations you handle often break new ground, and you dare to try directions others haven't. The greatest gift you give them is the belief that they too can make their own way.
七殺|子女.strength: You can bring out the potential in younger people and make them brave enough to try, and what you finish together brings real satisfaction. They also carry your drive into their own paths.
七殺|子女.watch: If you ask too much, too fast, and too directly, the younger ones will struggle to keep up. Give them some time to find their way, and the result may be better than you expect.
七殺|子女.ask_next: Which younger person or project do you most want to give a push right now?

七殺|財帛.title: Building income through action
七殺|財帛.plain: With Qi Sha in the Wealth Palace, you tend to earn by taking the initiative, opening up income through your own drive and judgment. You suit work that is challenging and shows results, and sales targets, projects, or starting a business can all let you shine. Your income may rise and fall: when it's good it comes fast, and it may go out fast too. Setting aside a sum you don't touch will give you more peace of mind. Your finances often shift along with changes in your work, and each change is also a new chance.
七殺|財帛.strength: You grab opportunities quickly and dare to make decisions others won't, so your income often takes a clear jump. With the right timing, one move can put you well ahead.
七殺|財帛.watch: Making a big decision on impulse is when you most need to brake. For any spending above the amount you set for yourself, list three reasons first, then decide.
七殺|財帛.ask_next: What kind of income source do you most want to build now? Why that one?

七殺|疾厄.title: After a sprint, remember to pull back
七殺|疾厄.plain: With Qi Sha in the Health Palace, we are talking about your daily rhythm, stress, and pace. You tend to push through in one go, and when busy you often forget to eat or sleep, only feeling tired once it's over. Your energy comes fast and leaves fast, so you need to plan recovery time on purpose. Exercise and working up a sweat are good outlets for you, and relax you better than holding it in. A routine with a clear start and end also suits you: when work is done, stop, and when you rest, truly rest.
七殺|疾厄.strength: Plenty of energy and quick reactions are your nature. You can get a lot done in a short time, and your state has real bursts of power. When you're at your best, no one can keep up.
七殺|疾厄.watch: Running until you're out of charge slows your recovery. After finishing each stage, plan a real rest before starting the next round.
七殺|疾厄.ask_next: When was the last time you truly rested and did nothing at all?

七殺|遷移.title: Making your own world out there
七殺|遷移.plain: With Qi Sha in the Travel Palace, you have more energy once you're out in a new environment. Leaving familiar places suits you, and business trips, postings abroad, or moving to a new city are often when you grow fastest. Out there you meet many challenges and changes, but you can usually handle them and find opportunities in them. The pace of moving around is fast, so remember to keep a place you can return to. The farther from home you go, the more clearly you see your own ability.
七殺|遷移.strength: Out in the world you are full of drive and dare to start something new, often producing results in unfamiliar settings that make people look twice. The less traveled the road, the more energy you put into it.
七殺|遷移.watch: Pushing too hard out there can leave no room for rest or planning. Before you set out, loosen the schedule and leave space for sudden changes. When you're tired, stop for a stop before moving on.
七殺|遷移.ask_next: If you could go to a new place right now and make your mark, where would you most want to go?

破軍|疾厄.title: Steadying the ups and downs of your daily rhythm
破軍|疾厄.plain: With Po Jun in the Health Palace, this is about your routine, stress, and daily pace. Your days are often a burst of busyness followed by a lull, and your routine easily shifts with events. You like trying new things, and when you get busy you can forget to rest, only noticing how tired you are once you stop. A few small habits that never change, like a fixed wake-up time, can steady you through the changes. What you need is not for everything to stay the same, but a few fixed anchors within the change.
破軍|疾厄.strength: You adapt well. You can quickly keep up when your environment or pace changes, and your spirit is flexible. In a new place, you soon find your own rhythm.
破軍|疾厄.watch: Times of change are when your routine is most easily thrown off. The busier you are, the more you need to protect your sleep and meal times. Steady the basics first, and the changes won't wear you down.
破軍|疾厄.ask_next: In your day, which habit do you most want to steady first?

破軍|遷移.title: A change of environment lets you start fresh
破軍|遷移.plain: With Po Jun in the Travel Palace, when you go out into the world and change your surroundings, it often feels like a fresh start, and your energy is fully switched on. You do well starting something new in a new place. Business trips, overseas postings, and moving away could all become turning points in your life. Out there you will meet many changes, some unexpected, but most bring you a new perspective. Stay flexible, and you can carve out a very different path outside. Often it's only after leaving the familiar that you discover what you truly want.
破軍|遷移.strength: You adapt quickly to new environments and dare to try things, and you often find opportunities out there you had never thought of. Change the place, and you seem like a different person, full of drive.
破軍|遷移.watch: When you decide to go, you often haven't arranged what's left behind. Before you leave, settle the things in your hands so you can go with a lighter mind. Say a proper goodbye to the people who deserve one.
破軍|遷移.ask_next: If you could start fresh in a new environment, which side of yourself would you most want to change?

破軍|交友.title: Your circle of friends often renews with each stage
破軍|交友.plain: With Po Jun in the Friends Palace, your circle of friends often renews with each stage of life, and each new environment brings a new group of people. You like spending time with people who have ideas and dare to do things differently. Some friends stay with you for a long time and some only for a stretch, which feels natural to you. With the friends you truly connect with, remember to put in some effort, so the bond lasts. You are also often the one in the group who brings new things and pulls everyone into trying them.
破軍|交友.strength: Through friends you come into contact with new fields and opportunities. Your circle is diverse and often brings you fresh inspiration. Some friends have even changed your direction.
破軍|交友.watch: Losing touch with old friends after changing environments is a bit of a pity. Reaching out with a message now and then can keep old bonds going. Old friends are often the ones who understand you best.
破軍|交友.ask_next: Is there a friend you haven't been in touch with for a long time, whom you've been thinking of lately?

破軍|官祿.title: Career with frequent shifts and breakthroughs
破軍|官祿.plain: With Po Jun in the Career Palace, your career often has a few big turns. You might change tracks or companies, or make major reforms in the role you already have. You suit work that needs innovation and change, such as startups, reworking processes, or developing new products. You dislike work that never changes, and the more a task requires breaking old ways, the more it interests you and the better results you produce. What you need most is an environment that allows you to try, and also allows you to make mistakes.
破軍|官祿.strength: You dare to reform, and you can open up a stalled situation. You often achieve standout results after changing tracks. Your changes often make a team feel renewed.
破軍|官祿.watch: Wanting to switch once the novelty fades is the most common tug-of-war in your career. Before you leave, ask yourself whether you want to escape something or truly want to move forward.
破軍|官祿.ask_next: If you could change one thing about your work right now, what would you most want to change?

破軍|田宅.title: Home often gets renewed as you change
破軍|田宅.plain: With Po Jun in the Property Palace, you often have the urge to remodel where you live. You like rearranging, swapping furniture, or even moving somewhere else. Your living situation may change with your life stages, and moving or renovating is nothing new to you. If your workspace has a bit of freshness, you will also feel more motivated. Every change is really you sorting yourself out. Your home often changes and grows along with your mood and life stage.
破軍|田宅.strength: You can turn where you live into the way you like it, and each adjustment makes life more comfortable. There is always something in your home that catches the eye.
破軍|田宅.watch: A sudden whim leads to a big overhaul that costs a lot of effort and money. Before you start, make a list and work in stages. Ask your family what they think before you begin.
破軍|田宅.ask_next: Which corner of your home do you most want to remodel right now? What would you like it to become?

破軍|福德.title: An inner pull toward freshness and freedom
破軍|福德.plain: With Po Jun in the Well-being Palace, you are inwardly drawn to freshness and freedom, and you always want to try what you haven't done before. Your interests may change often, and each phase teaches you something new. Your moods swing noticeably, hot one moment and cool the next, as you search for what you truly like. Give yourself a few small pleasures that can stay for the long term, and your heart will have a steady place to land. Your happiness often hides in the next new attempt, and this is a vitality that is yours alone.
破軍|福德.strength: You are full of curiosity and happy to try things, and you can find a lot of joy and inspiration in new experiences. You also often share fresh ideas with the people around you.
破軍|福德.watch: Wanting to switch when you feel bored may make you miss the rewards that come later. When you want to let go of something, give it a little more time first. What truly suits you often takes time to show.
破軍|福德.ask_next: Is there a new interest lately that you especially want to throw yourself into for a while?

破軍|父母.title: Views often differ from those of elders
破軍|父母.plain: With Po Jun in the Parents Palace, your views often differ from those of your parents, elders, and bosses, and you would rather go your own way. Elders may feel you change too easily, while you feel they are too conservative. This difference is really two generations seeing things from different angles. When you run into an unreasonable rule, you are often the one who wants to push for a new approach. If you can each hear the other's reasons out, you will often find you want about the same things.
破軍|父母.strength: You can persuade elders to accept new ideas, push for change within the rules, and show everyone different possibilities. Elders will slowly come to take pride in you.
破軍|父母.watch: If you argue with elders as soon as you open your mouth, the conversation is hard to continue. Start with small changes they can accept, build trust slowly, and then bring up the bigger ones.
破軍|父母.ask_next: What is one new idea you most want your elders to understand? Have they heard it before?
